official_description: Press diaphragm to evacuate air from lungs.

historical_description: Nail heel and toe cleats onto shoes.
official_description: Nail heel and toe cleats onto shoes.
followup_rationale: Nails puncturing footwear, pallet nailing and injuries to feet or people wearing shoes are described. No report establishes nailing cleats onto shoes.
rationale: Scaffold inspection, carton unjamming, lumber ripping, roof sheeting, and moving meat do not show attaching shoe cleats. Foot injuries and footwear descriptions are incidental.

historical_description: Train or supervise others in laying pipe.
official_description: Train or supervise others in laying pipe.
followup_rationale: A superintendent gives an instruction before pipe-laying, but its content and actual training/supervision of the pipe work are not detailed. Other reports describe laying pipe, an excavator warning, or lack of training. The earlier instruction is workflow context.
activity_quote: the site superintendent responsible for the overall jobsite instructed only one of the employees in the task to be performed.

rationale: A superintendent gives an instruction before pipe-laying, but its content and actual training/supervision of the pipe work are not detailed. Other reports describe laying pipe, an excavator warning, or lack of training. The earlier instruction is workflow context.

historical_description: Coordinate and supervise work of kitchen staff.
official_description: Coordinate and supervise work of kitchen staff.

incident_quote: Employee #1 was killed and the worker suffered minor injuries.
rationale: The store manager organized oven cleaning and directed a worker to remove its top, then was killed by gas released while preparing that work.
confirmation_rationale: The manager directs and coordinates a worker cleaning an oven in the cooking area and intervenes in the preparation; both are injured in the resulting gas explosion. Supervision is evidenced by instructions/actions, not title alone.

historical_description: Backfill piping trenches to protect pipes from damage.
official_description: Backfill piping trenches to protect pipes from damage.
followup_rationale: Backfilling behind silage-pit wall slabs is explicit and causes collapse injuries. It is not backfilling a piping trench to protect pipes. Other narratives contain piping work without backfill.
activity_quote: APPARENTLY THE DOZER OPERATOR MISUNDERSTOOD THE OWNER AND PROCEEDED TO BACKFILL THE SPACE BETWEEN THE SLABS AND EARTH WALL.
incident_quote: BOTH EMPLOYEES WERE HOSPITALIZED.
rationale: Backfilling behind silage-pit wall slabs is explicit and causes collapse injuries. It is not backfilling a piping trench to protect pipes. Other narratives contain piping work without backfill.

historical_description: Plan, direct, and supervise prescribed burn projects.
official_description: Plan, direct, and supervise prescribed burn projects.
followup_rationale: The reports contain chemical/electrical burns, waste burning in a pit, and fire response. None establishes planning, directing and supervising prescribed burns; a supervisor burning scrap is not the full task.
rationale: Burns stem from steel casting, electrical window work, reactor cleaning, and accidental gas explosion during cutting. No prescribed burning or its planning, direction, and supervision is shown. One report is empty.

historical_description: Load debris and refuse onto trucks and haul it away for disposal.
official_description: Load debris and refuse onto trucks and haul it away for disposal.
followup_rationale: Loading and distributing roofing debris in the dump truck are explicit, but hauling it away for disposal is not described as performed. activity_quote: He apparently emptied the trash into the hopper and pulled the packing lever to cycle the garbage packing mechanism to sweep the refuse into the truck.
incident_quote: Employee #1 was struck in the head and killed.
rationale: The laborer loaded refuse into a garbage truck and was killed by its movement, but hauling it away for disposal is not described for that incident actor. Other examples describe landfill dumping or quarry hauling, not both task conjuncts.

historical_description: Report defective equipment to appropriate supervisors or staff.
official_description: Report defective equipment to appropriate supervisors or staff.
followup_rationale: Equipment defects and recommendations to report them are described. The forklift driver phones his supervisor after injury, without stated communication of equipment defects. None establishes the task as a performed incident-linked action.
rationale: Cable cutting, crane checks, press operation, propellant mixing, and closure inspection show no report of defective equipment to supervisors. Noticing instability or removing defective products does not establish the task.

historical_description: Operate pumps connected to high-pressure hoses.
official_description: Operate pumps connected to high-pressure hoses.
followup_rationale: The supervisor operates high-pressure fracking pumps directly involved in the fatal line explosion, but connection through hoses rather than rigid piping is not established. Waterjet restart likewise gives a high-pressure line, not a hose; other reports concern pump handling/replacement or an incomplete hose incident.
activity_quote: An employee was operating a high pressure water sprayer.
incident_quote: The employee was electrocuted by an apparent ground fault in the portable light.
rationale: The endangered worker operated a high-pressure water sprayer, but a pump connected to high-pressure hoses is not expressly described. Another report explicitly starts hydraulic pumps but does not establish the hose qualification.

historical_description: Signal truck driver to position truck to facilitate pouring concrete, and move chute to direct concrete on forms.
official_description: Signal truck driver to position truck to facilitate pouring concrete, and move chute to direct concrete on forms.
followup_rationale: A truck is signaled to reverse for unloading, causing the fatal runover, but concrete pouring and chute movement are absent. Concrete-specific reports describe boom positioning, traffic direction or truck extraction, without both the driver-positioning signal and chute direction in the task.
activity_quote: The driver was given the signal to move the truck back for unloading,
incident_quote: The employee was killed.
rationale: A truck is signaled to reverse for unloading, causing the fatal runover, but concrete pouring and chute movement are absent. Concrete-specific reports describe boom positioning, traffic direction or truck extraction, without both the driver-positioning signal and chute direction in the task.

historical_description: Investigate the adequacy of ventilation, exhaust equipment, lighting, or other conditions that could affect employee health, comfort, or performance.
official_description: Investigate the adequacy of ventilation, exhaust equipment, lighting, or other conditions that could affect employee health, comfort, or performance.
followup_rationale: The reports describe ventilation deficiencies, exhaust exposure, paint spraying and adhesive application. Monitoring is explicitly absent in one case and an industrial hygiene consultant appears only as a post-incident corrective action in another. None establishes the proposed health-conditions investigation as incident-involved work.
activity_quote: They had been instructed to check for conditions inside a rectangular tank on the lower portion of rig barge #24.
incident_quote: Employee #1 climbed down a ladder into the tank where he was overcome due to insufficient oxygen.
rationale: Workers entered to check tank conditions and were overcome. Inspection is evidenced, but the narrative does not specify evaluating adequacy of ventilation or other conditions for employee health/performance; air readings were explicitly not taken.

historical_description: Operate on patient's musculoskeletal system to correct deformities, repair injuries, prevent and treat diseases, or improve or restore patient's functions.
official_description: Operate on patient's musculoskeletal system to correct deformities, repair injuries, prevent and treat diseases, or improve or restore patient's functions.
followup_rationale: The surgical language concerns treatment of injured workers after falls or shock. The only medical-work scene is adjustment of a light fixture above a patient bed; no incident-involved musculoskeletal surgery is described.
rationale: Musculoskeletal treatment and surgery follow ladder falls, roofing, glue lifting, and harvester maintenance. No surgeon is endangered or injured while operating.

historical_description: Disassemble and remove damaged or worn pipe.
official_description: Disassemble and remove damaged or worn pipe.
followup_rationale: The crew detaches and removes the damaged pipe-and-auger assembly from a fertilizer spreader, maneuvering its boot with pry bars and hoisting it. The removed assembly slips and crushes the worker hands. This establishes damaged-pipe disassembly/removal rather than handling undamaged new pipe.
activity_quote: Employees #1, #2 and #3 were removing a damaged 21 foot pipe and auger system
incident_quote: The pipe and auger system slipped from the chain and homemade hoisting apparatus crushing Employee #1's hands.
rationale: The crew detaches and removes the damaged pipe-and-auger assembly from a fertilizer spreader, maneuvering its boot with pry bars and hoisting it. The removed assembly slips and crushes the worker hands. This establishes damaged-pipe disassembly/removal rather than handling undamaged new pipe.
confirmation_rationale: The employees remove a damaged pipe-and-auger assembly from a fertilizer spreader, maneuvering its boot with pry bars and lifting it from the machine. This constitutes disassembly/removal of a damaged pipe assembly; its slipping during removal injures the participating worker.

historical_description: Raise vehicles, using hydraulic jacks.
official_description: Raise vehicles, using hydraulic jacks.

incident_quote: the jacks fell to the side, allowing the vehicle to fall on his chest.
rationale: Victim raised the truck with hydraulic jacks for brake-drum removal; their collapse fatally crushed him.
confirmation_rationale: The narrative identifies hydraulic jacks actually used to raise the truck; their collapse during the repair killed the worker. This establishes involvement although injury followed the initial raising.

historical_description: Work as a member of a team, rotating between chain saw operation and skidder operation.
official_description: Work as a member of a team, rotating between chain saw operation and skidder operation.
followup_rationale: Chainsaw operation while cutting a limb is directly evidenced in the injury. Team rotation between chainsaw and skidder operation is not described. activity_quote: an employee was working with a chain saw and lifted a tree limb off the ground to cut it.
incident_quote: The employee lacerated his finger with the chain saw blade.
rationale: Chainsaw operation while cutting a limb is directly evidenced in the injury. Team rotation between chainsaw and skidder operation is not described. Other examples use rotating chains on a conveyor/trencher or manufacturing machine, rather than the specified logging team rotation.

historical_description: Unload materials and tools from work trucks, and unroll roofing as directed.
official_description: Unload materials and tools from work trucks, and unroll roofing as directed.
activity_quote: HE UNLOADED THE FIRST LENGTH OF PIPE. WHEN IT WAS ON THE GROUND HE PULLED HIS TRUCK AHEAD AND STARTED TO UNLOAD THE SECOND PIPE.
incident_quote: HIS HIP AND PELVIS WERE CAUGHT AND CRUSHED BETWEEN TWO EIGHT-FOOT LENGTHS OF PIPE (EACH WEIGHING 12,720 POUNDS).
rationale: Truck unloading is explicit and the pipe rolled onto the unloading worker. Unloading tools and unrolling roofing are not evidenced.

historical_description: Operate safety equipment and use safe work habits.
official_description: Operate safety equipment and use safe work habits.
activity_quote: ALL THE EMPLOYEES WERE USING SAFETY BELTS AND LANYARDS.
incident_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 WAS TIED TO A SAFETY LINE BUT THE LINE WAS STRUCK BY SOMETHING AND BROKE OFF 8 FEET ABOVE THE EMPLOYEE'S TIE OFF POINT.

confirmation_rationale: Actual use of safety belts/lanyards and tie-off documents safety-equipment use and a protective work practice. The tied-off worker fell after the platform and safety line failed. This does not imply safety equipment caused the injury or that every practice was safe.

historical_description: Direct other workers to move stakes, place blocks, position anchors or cables, or move materials.
official_description: Direct other workers to move stakes, place blocks, position anchors or cables, or move materials.
activity_quote: The employee had hooked two wire ropes to the skip, then stood outside the perimeter ropes and radioed the tower crane to raise the skip.
incident_quote: When the weight was taken up by the crane, the skip swung out from under the perimeter rope, causing Employee #1 to fall 13 ft to the first floor.
rationale: The endangered employee radioed the crane operator to raise a trash skip; this is directing another worker to move materials.
confirmation_rationale: Radioing the crane to raise a trash-filled skip directs another worker to move materials, one explicit alternative in the task. The movement caused the fall.

historical_description: Direct workers engaged in placing blocks or outriggers to prevent capsizing of machines when lifting heavy loads.
official_description: Direct workers engaged in placing blocks or outriggers to prevent capsizing of machines when lifting heavy loads.
rationale: Lift operation, moving a fan, beam connection, directing truss staging and loader servicing are described; none directs workers placing machine-stabilizing blocks or outriggers. The lifting-device narrative is truncated.

historical_description: Clean shop, work area, and machines, using solvent and rags.
official_description: Clean shop, work area, and machines, using solvent and rags.

incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained a fractured forearm.
rationale: Victim cleaned machine feed rolls with solvent and rag, which pulled him into rolls. Machine-cleaning component is exact; cleaning the shop and work area is not established.

historical_description: Issue supplies and equipment to workers.
official_description: Issue supplies and equipment to workers.
rationale: Roof work, acid-valve replacement, steam cleaning, trench work, and aerial-lift operation involve using supplies or equipment, but do not describe issuing them to workers.

historical_description: Drive crew trucks to and from work areas.
official_description: Drive crew trucks to and from work areas.

incident_quote: WHEN THE TRUCK BEGAN TO MOVE EMPLOYEE #1 FELL OFF THE BACK AND STRUCK HIS HEAD ON A CONCRETE SLAB.
rationale: A driver moved a truck carrying his coworker toward a work area and the coworker fell. The vehicle is a freight flatbed, with no evidence it is a crew truck.

historical_description: Pull down loose rock that cannot be supported.
official_description: Pull down loose rock that cannot be supported.
rationale: Crane collision, trench collapse, tanker cleaning, straightening stored material, and backfilling behind slabs show no intentional pulling down unsupported loose rock.

rationale: The supervisor permitted an unqualified crew member to perform replacement work near an energized switch, directly exposing that worker to the fatal contact.

official_description: Order surgical supplies.
rationale: Forklift/conveyor crushing and oil-pump fire are described; surgery is subsequent treatment, with no surgical supply ordering activity.

official_description: Direct or monitor other workers producing chemical products.
rationale: The painting supervisor directs pump use, not chemical-product production. Other cases concern degreaser evacuation, accidental cleaner mixing, chemical unloading, and investigating blender emissions; directing or monitoring chemical-production workers is not established.

historical_description: Replace valve stems and remove puncturing objects.
official_description: Replace valve stems and remove puncturing objects.
rationale: Replacing a propane tank valve or removing a gate valve is not replacing valve stems; other examples involve press operation, loader repair and crane repairs. No puncturing-object removal is described.

historical_description: Maneuver completed roofing units into position for installation.
official_description: Maneuver completed roofing units into position for installation.

rationale: Victim placed roofing panels and fell while returning for another panel, establishing maneuvering roofing units for installation.
confirmation_rationale: Placing roofing panels documents maneuvering roofing units for installation. The fatal fall occurred while returning to the bundle as part of that work cycle.

historical_description: Transport items to work or storage areas, using carts.
official_description: Transport items to work or storage areas, using carts.

incident_quote: HIS HEAD WAS CRUSHED BETWEEN THE BUNDLE AND A HEAVY ANGLE IRON GUARD RAIL.
rationale: The injured employee participated in transferring steel tubing on tow carts to manufacturing and unloading those carts, during which the load fell.
confirmation_rationale: Worker transported warehouse stock by hand cart through the warehouse and was pinned during that transport. Report 686469 also explicitly describes cart transport from receiving to manufacturing preceding unloading.

historical_description: Cut or break flashing from materials or products.
official_description: Cut or break flashing from materials or products.
rationale: Crane/load handling, concrete-form removal, fuse replacement and positioning a trailer floor do not describe cutting or breaking manufacturing flashing.

historical_description: Saw back-cuts, leaving sufficient sound wood to control direction of fall.
official_description: Saw back-cuts, leaving sufficient sound wood to control direction of fall.
rationale: Forklift spotting, cutback-saw stock cutting, line repair, backhoe activity, and wheel changing do not establish tree back-cuts or retaining hinge wood.

historical_description: Assign employees to specific duties.
official_description: Assign employees to specific duties.
rationale: Reports describe assigned orange picking, reassignment to cleanup, a mechanic called to assist, and workers outside assigned duties. official_description: Crank trailer landing gear up or down to safely secure vehicles.
rationale: Dumping concrete, unloading, stacking trailers and crane hoisting do not describe cranking trailer landing gear. Report 659631 is empty and 890517 ends before completing the injury account.

historical_description: Signal workers to move loaded cars.
official_description: Signal workers to move loaded cars.
rationale: Road shoulder spreading, standing near tanker, pumping by road, standing behind lift truck, and water hauling show no signals to move loaded cars.

historical_description: Dust rocks after bolting.
official_description: Dust rocks after bolting.
rationale: Debris demolition, copper cleanup, grain-dust ignition, heating rust preventive, and fighting a dust fire do not establish dusting rocks after bolting. The last narrative is truncated.

historical_description: Instruct customers in alteration of products.
official_description: Instruct customers in alteration of products.
rationale: Transformer replacement, wheelabrator operation, punch-press work, chipper cleaning and a manager directing fryer isolation contain no customers instructed to alter products. Chipper narrative is truncated after describing injury.

historical_description: Set up scaffolding to provide safe access to roofs.
official_description: Set up scaffolding to provide safe access to roofs.
rationale: Moving a scaffold on a rail cart, roof-panel/ridge-cap installation, powered-platform roof access, and moving an opening cover do not show scaffold setup for safe roof access.

historical_description: Set up and use ladders and scaffolding as necessary to complete work.
official_description: Set up and use ladders and scaffolding as necessary to complete work.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1, A BRICK MASON, WAS WORKING AT THE SECOND LEVEL OF A TUBULAR WELDED FRAME SCAFFOLD TRYING TO RAISE THE SCAFFOLD TO A THIRD LEVEL.
incident_quote: THE MOMENTUM OF THE FALLING FRAME CARRIED EMPLOYEE #1 BACKWARDS OFF THE SCAFFOLD.
rationale: The mason both used and erected scaffolding and fell during erection. Ladder setup and use, also named in the task, are not shown in that incident. Separate ladder-use cases do not establish setup.

historical_description: Signal coworkers to synchronize flow of materials.
official_description: Signal coworkers to synchronize flow of materials.
rationale: Loading cable reels, hoisting board sheets, chipping concrete and repairing trailer suspension involve cooperation but do not establish signaling coworkers to synchronize material flow. official_description: Supervise subordinate employees.

confirmation_rationale: Supervisor directly instructed the subordinate operating the irrigation system during their joint troubleshooting operation. The subordinate was electrocuted at the control panel; proof that the instruction caused the fault is not required.

historical_description: Dump refuse or recyclable materials at disposal sites.
official_description: Dump refuse or recyclable materials at disposal sites.

rationale: Dumping a load containing tree roots and stumps at a designated dump site directly preceded the fatal trailer overturn.
confirmation_rationale: Employee dumped excavated/vegetative debris at an explicitly identified dump site, and the dump trailer toppled during unloading.

historical_description: Brief workers on radiation levels in work areas.
official_description: Brief workers on radiation levels in work areas.

incident_quote: THE BOOM CONTACTED THE OVERHEAD LINE, AND THE EMPLOYEE WAS ELECTROCUTED.
rationale: Truck driver was unloading cement using its boom when electrocuted. Unloading is established but loading is not; gasoline-unloading account is truncated before outcome.

historical_description: Climb ladders to reach aircraft surfaces to be cleaned.
official_description: Climb ladders to reach aircraft surfaces to be cleaned.

incident_quote: He fell face down into accumulated water and died.
rationale: The victim climbed a ladder into a barge tank to check conditions, supporting ladder climbing only. Neither aircraft surfaces nor cleaning purpose is shown; tanker cleaning concerns road vehicles.

historical_description: Follow established surgical techniques during the operation.

rationale: Press use, air-conditioner repair, crane lowering, nitrogen testing and tank cleaning are the incident activities. Surgical repair is later treatment, not an exposed surgical worker.

rationale: Conveyor troubleshooting, washing, inspection with gearbox removal, unjamming, and electrical component replacement do not establish installing gears and holding devices. Disassembly during inspection is not installation.

confirmation_rationale: Worker set up a ladder to caulk an elevated window; the ladder slipped when used.

official_description: String cables through pulleys and blocks.

historical_description: Anchor steel supports from ceiling joists to hold pipes in place.
official_description: Anchor steel supports from ceiling joists to hold pipes in place.
rationale: Ceiling duct connection, failure of previously installed steam-line supports, hoist-supported pipe movement, scaffold assembly, and flue flashing do not establish anchoring steel supports from ceiling joists for pipes.

historical_description: Work from ladders, scaffolds, or roofs to install, maintain, or repair electrical wiring, equipment, or fixtures.
official_description: Work from ladders, scaffolds, or roofs to install, maintain, or repair electrical wiring, equipment, or fixtures.

incident_quote: The employee, who was touching the aluminum ground wire, was electrocuted.
rationale: The power-line worker used an extension ladder while reattaching a sagging line and was electrocuted when it shifted.
confirmation_rationale: Worker used a ladder while repairing a sagging electrical line, and ladder contact energized his work position and electrocuted him.

historical_description: Unclamp workpieces and remove them from machines.

historical_description: Supply, operate, or maintain personal protective equipment.
official_description: Supply, operate, or maintain personal protective equipment.
rationale: Accounts explicitly describe PPE absent, unused, merely available, or covered by prior training. None establishes supplying, operating, or maintaining PPE as incident activity.

official_description: Maintain cleanliness of work area.

incident_quote: THE VACUUM NOZZLE WAS PULLED BETWEEN THE ROLLER AND BELT, PULLING THE EMPLOYEE'S ARM INTO THE ROLLER BELT.
rationale: The injured worker vacuumed spilled coal beneath a moving conveyor to keep the work area clear, drawing his arm into the belt.
confirmation_rationale: Vacuuming accumulated spilled coal from the work area under the conveyor directly meets maintaining cleanliness.

incident_quote: Employee #1 became caught between the trailer and a truck belonging to Mountain Fuel.
rationale: The injured warehouse worker spotted a driver positioning a trailer for loading; directions to laborers packing and moving goods onto trailers are not established.

historical_description: Cut pipe and lift up to fitters.

rationale: Removing electrical pipe jumpers, shearing sheet metal, moving casing to racks, crane moving furnace pipe, and loader service do not establish cutting pipe or lifting it to fitters.

activity_quote: HE MADE THE REPAIRS, THEN MOUNTED AND INFLATED THE TIRES TO 105 PSI.
incident_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 SUFFERED MASSIVE HEAD AND CHEST INJURIES.
rationale: The worker repaired rims, remounted tires, and continued checking and repairing the assembly that exploded. This establishes tire reassembly within the incident sequence. One other supplied report is empty.
confirmation_rationale: Worker mounted tires on repaired rims and then checked/repaired the same assembly that exploded. Reassembly is explicit and directly part of the incident sequence. Last report 785774 has no reconstructed narrative.

historical_description: Supervise other butchers or meat cutters.

rationale: Meat processing, grinding, bagging, pallet sawing and meat-saw servicing contain no supervision of other butchers or meat cutters.

rationale: Victim activated a freight elevator after loading peanuts and was crushed; elevator operation is supported, but conjunction with conveyor systems is not.

historical_description: Diagnose and treat conditions involving injury to the central nervous system, such as cerebrovascular accidents, neoplasms, infectious or inflammatory diseases, degenerative diseases, head traumas, demyelinating diseases, and various forms of dementing illnesses.
official_description: Diagnose and treat conditions involving injury to the central nervous system, such as cerebrovascular accidents, neoplasms, infectious or inflammatory diseases, degenerative diseases, head traumas, demyelinating diseases, and various forms of dementing illnesses.
rationale: Head and brain damage are injury outcomes of scaffold, roof, and floor-opening falls. The narratives do not describe an endangered clinician diagnosing and treating nervous-system injury.

historical_description: Maintain high tension lines, de-energizing lines for power companies when repairs are requested.
activity_quote: HE THEN TRIED TO USE A WIRE BRUSH TO CLEAN A DEENERGIZED 34.5-KILOVOLT CONNECTION WHICH WAS NEAR AN ENERGIZED 34.5-KILOVOLT LINE.
incident_quote: HE RECEIVED AN ELECTRIC SHOCK AND BURNS TO HIS FINGERS, WRISTS, ANKLES, AND FEET.
rationale: Cleaning a high-voltage connection evidences maintenance; worker de-energization for requested repairs is not established, and the narrative explicitly says the substation had no reported problem.

historical_description: Repair, rewire, and troubleshoot electrical systems.
official_description: Repair, rewire, and troubleshoot electrical systems.
activity_quote: During the repair, the electrician was turning the machine off and on.
incident_quote: his head and shoulder were caught between the roller bed and conveyor table.
rationale: Electrician repaired the carpet machine while cycling power, exposing janitor to dropping roller bed. Repair component is supported; rewiring and troubleshooting are not both established in this event.

historical_description: Guide cranes to move loads about decks.
official_description: Guide cranes to move loads about decks.
activity_quote: TWO EMPLOYEES RIGGED THE DECKING, AND THEY GUIDED IT WITH THEIR HANDS AS THE CRANE WAS MOVING IT.
incident_quote: ONE OF THE TWO EMPLOYEES GUIDING THE LOAD WAS STANDING ON WET SOIL AND RECEIVED AN ELECTRIC SHOCK AND ELECTRICAL BURNS TO BOTH HANDS, TO BOTH FEET, AND TO HIS CHEST.
rationale: The injured worker guided crane-suspended roof decking, but material called decking is not evidence of moving loads about decks.

historical_description: Investigate complaints regarding safety violations.
official_description: Investigate complaints regarding safety violations.
activity_quote: a police officer was dispatched to investigate a report of downed trees and a downed overhead power line.
incident_quote: The first officer was lying on the road with his feet in contact with an 8000-volt overhead power line that had been knocked down by tree limbs.
rationale: The officer investigated a reported downed line and was electrocuted at the scene; a complaint alleging safety violations is not established. Other investigations occurred after unrelated injuries.

historical_description: Investigate mechanical failures or unexpected maintenance problems.
official_description: Investigate mechanical failures or unexpected maintenance problems.
activity_quote: Employee #1, a maintenance worker, used a Yale stock picker lift, serial #SS030BAN-24ST111, #N442438, to elevate himself 25 ft to listen to a noise coming from a conveyor motor.
incident_quote: it contacted the underside of the running conveyor belt and motor roller, resulting in multiple fractures.
rationale: Maintenance worker elevated himself specifically to investigate conveyor-motor noise and was injured by its moving belt/roller.
confirmation_rationale: Listening to an abnormal motor noise is investigation of a mechanical problem; the worker was injured while doing that inspection.

historical_description: Unload and assemble pipes and pumping equipment, using hand tools.
official_description: Unload and assemble pipes and pumping equipment, using hand tools.
activity_quote: Employee #1 and a coworker were laying pipe in a 60 ft long trench that was 8 to 23 ft deep, and varied in width from 3 to 4 ft at the bottom to 10 to 12 ft at the top.
incident_quote: Both employees were in the trench when the side wall caved in, trapping Employee #1. He died of asphyxia due to chest compression.
rationale: The victim laid pipe with a coworker while another handed down pipe and hand tools. This supports pipe installation, but unloading and assembling both pipe and pumping equipment is not established.

historical_description: Hammer out dents and twists in tools and equipment.
official_description: Hammer out dents and twists in tools and equipment.
rationale: Pipe fitting removal, cord retrieval, loader operation, ladder climbing and rigging do not show hammering dents or twists. The hammer in the rigging example accidentally snagged controls.

historical_description: Restrain or aid patients as necessary to prevent injury.
official_description: Restrain or aid patients as necessary to prevent injury.
rationale: Window-cover installation, press setup/operation, oil-unit dismantling, and conveyor unjamming show no patient restraint or assistance. Press restraints are machine safeguards, not patient care.

historical_description: Sprinkle chemicals over molten metal to bring impurities to the surface.
official_description: Sprinkle chemicals over molten metal to bring impurities to the surface.
rationale: Welding tanks, shearing contaminated pipe, lifting a molten-metal ladle, and flushing paint lines are described. None involves sprinkling chemicals on molten metal to remove impurities.

historical_description: Set ladders, scaffolds, and hoists in place for taking supplies to roofs.
official_description: Set ladders, scaffolds, and hoists in place for taking supplies to roofs.
activity_quote: After lunch, they moved the scaffold around to the northeastern end of the building.
incident_quote: He ran to the edge of the roof and saw the scaffold hanging by one hook and Employee #1 lying on the ground. Employee #1 was killed.
rationale: Workers repositioned a scaffold associated with a fatal fall; setting ladders and hoists and a purpose of taking supplies to roofs are not established.

historical_description: Treat minor cuts, abrasions, or contusions.
official_description: Treat minor cuts, abrasions, or contusions.
rationale: Climbing falls, crane tipover, and scaffold collapse produce cuts and contusions but show no caregiver endangered while treating them. One source is empty.

historical_description: Operate cranes to move or load baskets, casks, or canisters.
official_description: Operate cranes to move or load baskets, casks, or canisters.

incident_quote: THE CRANE CONTACTED AN OVERHEAD POWER LINE, AND THE EMPLOYEE RECEIVED AN ELECTRIC SHOCK FOR WHICH HE WAS HOSPITALIZED.
rationale: A crane moved a cement bucket during the electrical-contact incident, supporting crane load movement. The load is not identified as a basket, cask, or canister. The steel-bar narrative is truncated before any incident.

historical_description: Apply and release hand brakes.
official_description: Apply and release hand brakes.
rationale: Metal-forming press brakes, an unused sweeper foot brake and sanding an elevator brake drum do not establish applying and releasing hand brakes.

historical_description: Inspect and adjust crane mechanisms or lifting accessories to prevent malfunctions or damage.
official_description: Inspect and adjust crane mechanisms or lifting accessories to prevent malfunctions or damage.
activity_quote: IN THE PROCESS OF TESTING THE CRANE'S OPERATION FOR STABILITY, THE OPERATOR SWUNG THE BOOM AROUND
incident_quote: CAUSING THE COUNTERWEIGHT OF THE SUPERSTRUCTURE TO STRIKE AND FATALLY INJURE THE OILER (EMPLOYEE #1).
rationale: Crane operator tested stability after repair and swung counterweight into oiler. Functional inspection/testing is supported, but adjustment of mechanism/accessories is not established.

historical_description: Signal workers to discharge, dump, or level materials.

historical_description: Direct work crews in the cleaning and repair of furnace walls and flooring.
official_description: Direct work crews in the cleaning and repair of furnace walls and flooring.
rationale: Moving a fan, an unexplained fall beside a furnace, tank dismantling, building demolition and steel erection do not show directing crews to clean and repair furnace walls/flooring. The furnace case explicitly says the activity could not be reconstructed.

historical_description: Move trailing electrical cables clear of obstructions, using rubber safety gloves.
official_description: Move trailing electrical cables clear of obstructions, using rubber safety gloves.
rationale: Power-line installation, current-transformer installation, rubber rolling, and cleaning a high-voltage cable show no moving trailing cables clear of obstructions. Insulating glove use alone does not establish that action. One source is empty.

historical_description: Change dies on extruding machines, according to production line changes.
official_description: Change dies on extruding machines, according to production line changes.
rationale: Press cleaning, solvent-system removal, pallet loading, ammonia-system pressure, and noodle-line clearing do not establish die changes on extrusion equipment.

historical_description: Decontaminate ambulance interior following treatment of patient with infectious disease, and report case to proper authorities.
official_description: Decontaminate ambulance interior following treatment of patient with infectious disease, and report case to proper authorities.

historical_description: Clean up spilled oil by bailing it into barrels.
official_description: Clean up spilled oil by bailing it into barrels.
rationale: Oil transfer/gauging, tanker steaming, fryer cleaning/refilling, paint dipping, and sandblasting show no bailing spilled oil into barrels. Fryer oil was spilled during return, not cleaned up.

historical_description: Notify supervisors or repair staff of mechanical malfunctions.
official_description: Notify supervisors or repair staff of mechanical malfunctions.

historical_description: Direct truck drivers backing vehicles into loading bays and cover, uncover, or secure loads for delivery.
official_description: Direct truck drivers backing vehicles into loading bays and cover, uncover, or secure loads for delivery.

incident_quote: EMPLOYEE #1'S HEAD WAS CRUSHED BETWEEN THE TRAILER AND DOCK WALL.
rationale: A coworker guided the truck into the dock involved in the crushing incident, but covering, uncovering or securing a delivery load is not evidenced. The final movement signal is not specified.

official_description: Unload materials, devices, and machine parts, using hand tools.

official_description: Press garments, using hand irons or pressing machines.
rationale: Metal press forming, fabric rolling and pressure-cooker operation do not describe garment pressing with irons or pressing machines.

official_description: Guard facility entrances to screen visitors.

rationale: Container crane movement, dock cleanup/electrical installation, suspended boat repair and loading crane boom sections do not establish positioning booms around docked ships.

rationale: Air-conditioner electrical fault, welding new decking, scaffold brickwork, cyclone repair, and TIG baffle repair do not establish welding broken/cracked frames with oxyacetylene and rods. Incidental welded frames or weld failure are insufficient.

historical_description: Test atmosphere for adequate oxygen or explosive conditions when working in confined spaces.
official_description: Test atmosphere for adequate oxygen or explosive conditions when working in confined spaces.
rationale: Atmospheric measurements are explicitly post-event or taken by the responding fire chief. Other reports describe deficient atmospheres or omitted testing; no affected worker tests confined-space oxygen or explosion conditions.

historical_description: Prescribe medications for the treatment of athletic-related injuries.
official_description: Prescribe medications for the treatment of athletic-related injuries.
rationale: Power-line work, rigging concrete panels, tower climbing and a grader runover show injuries, not prescribing medications for athletic injuries. Report 779462 is empty; 1003664 has corrupted injury wording.

historical_description: Sweep, shovel, or vacuum loose debris or salvageable scrap into containers and remove containers from work areas.
official_description: Sweep, shovel, or vacuum loose debris or salvageable scrap into containers and remove containers from work areas.
activity_quote: The vacuum truck was connected to the hopper and was in operation when an explosion occurred in the hopper and flames shot upward to where the three employees were working.
incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained third-degree burns over 98 percent of his body and died en route to the Chicago Burn Center.
rationale: Vacuum dust removal was operating while workers removed collector bags and were burned by explosion. Vacuum collection is supported, but removal of filled containers from work areas is not stated.

historical_description: Install handrails under the direction of a carpenter.
official_description: Install handrails under the direction of a carpenter.
rationale: Moving beams, carpenter drilling, plywood decking, tree trimming, and installing crane rails are observed. Crane rails are not handrails, and carpenter-directed handrail installation is not established.

historical_description: Determine brain death using accepted tests and procedures.
official_description: Determine brain death using accepted tests and procedures.
rationale: Machinery trauma, forklift collision, decking collapse and natural deaths contain death findings or autopsies after the event, not an endangered worker testing brain death.

historical_description: Climb poles or use truck-mounted buckets to access equipment.
official_description: Climb poles or use truck-mounted buckets to access equipment.
activity_quote: A power line crew was replacing transformers on a utility pole. One of the power line workers on the crew climbed the pole.
incident_quote: The conductive object contacted the power line, and the employee was electrocuted.
rationale: Victim climbed utility pole to access transformers during replacement and contacted the overhead line.
confirmation_rationale: The worker climbed the pole to reach transformer work and was electrocuted there.

historical_description: Assist with patient resuscitation during cardiac arrest or other life-threatening events.
official_description: Assist with patient resuscitation during cardiac arrest or other life-threatening events.
rationale: Cardiac arrest and CPR concern prior victims; no harmed resuscitation provider is identified. The meat-saw report mentions a later shock to another employee but does not connect that shock to resuscitation. Two sources are empty.

historical_description: Treat bone, muscle, and joint disorders affecting the feet and ankles.
official_description: Treat bone, muscle, and joint disorders affecting the feet and ankles.
rationale: Window washing/caulking, ladder climbing, roofing and forklift adjustment produce limb injuries. Subsequent treatment is not an incident involving a clinician treating foot/ankle disorders.

historical_description: Inspect the cleanliness and practices of establishment employees.
official_description: Inspect the cleanliness and practices of establishment employees.
rationale: Coal-car cleaning, cutting an uncleaned fuel tank, and insulation installation show no inspection of employee cleanliness/practices. Recommendations and investigations are after the accidents. Two sources are empty.

historical_description: Design and build safety equipment.
official_description: Design and build safety equipment.
rationale: Safety guards, lifelines, skylight screens, and harnesses are absent, unused, or recommended during other work. No affected worker designs and builds safety equipment.

historical_description: Talk to customers or refer to work orders to establish the nature of appliance malfunctions.
official_description: Talk to customers or refer to work orders to establish the nature of appliance malfunctions.
rationale: Sweeping, line installation, fryer cleaning, lift malfunction handling and lamp troubleshooting do not establish consulting customers or work orders about appliance malfunctions.

historical_description: Assist workers in tasks, such as loading vehicles.
official_description: Assist workers in tasks, such as loading vehicles.
activity_quote: After the pipe racks had been loaded onto the trailer, Employee #1 left the cab of the truck to assist the coworker in securing the pipe racks.
incident_quote: before the pipe racks could be secured they fell off and crushed and killed Employee #1.
rationale: Victim explicitly assisted coworker securing pipe racks just loaded on a trailer and was crushed when they fell.
confirmation_rationale: The injured employee actively assisted the coworker with loading by operating the winch, then moved to help secure that same load; the racks fell onto him.

historical_description: Guide lengths of pipe into and out of elevators.
official_description: Guide lengths of pipe into and out of elevators.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was lowering pipe with a roustabout winch through a mechanical shaft in a newly constructed building.
incident_quote: The roustabout was not set up properly and the limit was exceeded, tipping the roustabout into the shaft and taking Employee #1 with it. He was killed by the fall.
rationale: The worker lowered pipe through a building shaft using a roustabout winch. This supports pipe handling but not guiding lengths into and out of pipe elevators. Other elevator cases involve peanuts or platforms, not pipe.

historical_description: Depress pedals to collapse drums after processing is complete.
official_description: Depress pedals to collapse drums after processing is complete.
rationale: Heat collapse, torch-cutting drum lids and press-brake forming do not establish depressing a pedal to collapse a processed drum. Report 565564 is empty.

historical_description: Assign truck drivers or recycling technicians to routes.
official_description: Assign truck drivers or recycling technicians to routes.
rationale: Spotting dump trucks, specifying a dumping location, retrieving a glove, scrap loading, and directing a short on-site drive are observed. None assigns drivers or recycling technicians to routes.

historical_description: Drive machines into position at working faces.
official_description: Drive machines into position at working faces.
rationale: Machine mounting, skid-steer servicing, road profilograph use, confined-space sealing, and roof-panel placement are shown. No machine is driven into position at a working face.

historical_description: Climb ladders to position and set up vehicle-mounted derricks.
official_description: Climb ladders to position and set up vehicle-mounted derricks.
activity_quote: Employee #1 did not wait; he climbed the ladder and started attaching the sling.
incident_quote: He pitched forward face-first, striking the ladder and then the concrete floor, and was killed.
rationale: The affected worker climbed a ladder for attaching lifting slings to a tank; positioning or setting up a vehicle-mounted derrick is not established. Report 735019 is empty.

historical_description: Sandblast exposed areas of glass to cut designs in surfaces, using spray guns.
official_description: Sandblast exposed areas of glass to cut designs in surfaces, using spray guns.
rationale: Nail-gun roofing, tire inflation, spraying lacquer on boots, cabinet sanding, and pressure-cleaning a valve box do not show sandblasting designs into glass.

historical_description: Correct problems by adjusting controls or by stopping machines and opening holding devices.
official_description: Correct problems by adjusting controls or by stopping machines and opening holding devices.
activity_quote: As Employee #1 got behind the uptake and began to straighten the wire, the operator jogged the machine to circle the wirefeed, without seeing or thinking about Employee #1.
incident_quote: His right arm was pulled into the machine by the mesh and slightly fractured.
rationale: The operator used machine controls to address a wire-feed problem, jogging the equipment while the helper was straightening wire and directly injuring him.
confirmation_rationale: Operator manipulated the machine controls to jog the wire feed while correcting a feed problem, directly injuring the helper. This establishes the controls branch; the alternative stopping-and-opening branch need not also be met. Report 828699 lacks narrative.

historical_description: Place blocks under reinforcing bars used to reinforce floors.
official_description: Place blocks under reinforcing bars used to reinforce floors.
activity_quote: THEY HAD PLACED WOODEN BLOCKS ON THE FLOOR TO HOLD THE LOAD.
incident_quote: HIS HEAD WAS CRUSHED BETWEEN THE BUNDLE AND A HEAVY ANGLE IRON GUARD RAIL.
rationale: Placing/straightening support blocks beneath a steel load is established and involved the crushed worker, but the load is tubing, not reinforcing bars used in a floor.

historical_description: Dig holes, using augers, and set poles, using cranes and power equipment.
official_description: Dig holes, using augers, and set poles, using cranes and power equipment.
activity_quote: AN EMPLOYEE WAS USING AN AUGER TO DIG HOLES FOR ANCHORS FOR A MOBILE HOME.
incident_quote: A GROUND FAULT ON THE AUGER ELECTROCUTED THE EMPLOYEE.
rationale: Victim dug anchor holes with an auger and was electrocuted; setting poles using cranes/power equipment is not established in this incident.

historical_description: Inspect, repair, or replace brake systems.
official_description: Inspect, repair, or replace brake systems.
activity_quote: On December 14, 1994, Employee #1 was removing brake drums from a 10,300 pound fleet truck. His employer was going to troubleshoot the brake drums.
incident_quote: As Employee #1 was attempting to remove the left rear drum, the jacks fell to the side, allowing the vehicle to fall on his chest. Employee #1 died.
rationale: The worker was removing truck brake drums as part of troubleshooting the brakes when the unsupported truck fell onto him. This is brake-system service work.
confirmation_rationale: Brake-drum removal is active disassembly of the brake system for troubleshooting/repair, not merely operation of defective brakes; worker was crushed during removal.

historical_description: Install and set up medical equipment, using hand tools.
rationale: Table-saw work, press setup, power-line installation, printing press servicing and blender-shaft positioning are described; none installs medical equipment using hand tools.

historical_description: Inspect work sites for obstructions or holes that could cause structural weakness.
official_description: Inspect work sites for obstructions or holes that could cause structural weakness.
rationale: Truss placement, telephone call near construction, roof demolition, and checking siding measurements show no inspection for obstructions/holes causing structural weakness. Findings of inadequate bracing/unchecked scaffold boards are retrospective. One source is empty.

historical_description: Estimate materials and labor required to complete roofing jobs.
official_description: Estimate materials and labor required to complete roofing jobs.
rationale: Roof insulation, equipment installation, riding a crane hook, laying roofing, and applying sealant are described. None establishes estimating both roofing materials and labor. One source ends during transport details.

historical_description: Control traffic.
official_description: Control traffic.
activity_quote: Using a hand-held stop sign, Employee #1 signaled his lane of traffic to stop.
incident_quote: turned back around and was struck in the head by the truck's right side fender.
rationale: The injured flagger was actively stopping traffic with a sign when struck by an approaching truck.
confirmation_rationale: Flagger explicitly controlled traffic using a stop sign and was struck by an approaching truck during that duty.

historical_description: Inspect manholes to locate sewer line stoppages.
official_description: Inspect manholes to locate sewer line stoppages.
activity_quote: AN EMPLOYEE ENTERED A 30 FOOT DEEP SEWER MANHOLE TO CHECK ON THE WATER LEVEL.
incident_quote: HE TRIED TO CLIMB OUT, BUT FELL UNCONSCIOUS INTO ABOUT FORTY INCHES OF WATER AT THE BOTTOM.
rationale: Victim entered a sewer manhole to inspect water level and was overcome. Locating a sewer stoppage is unsupported; account says line was not in service and groundwater leaked in.

historical_description: Clamp seals around valves to secure tanks.
official_description: Clamp seals around valves to secure tanks.
rationale: The cylinder incident involves loosening a clamp during checking, not clamping seals around valves to secure tanks. Other examples concern tank entry, sludge removal, tank loading, and platform construction.

historical_description: Shovel blacktop.
official_description: Shovel blacktop.
rationale: Forklift operation, pipe laying, shoveling crushed ice, drilling and retrieving a shovel do not establish shoveling blacktop; rescue shoveling concerns soil after the collapse.

historical_description: Replace motors.
official_description: Replace motors.

incident_quote: As the employee was cleaning the bottom of the feed opening, he touched the metal frame with his hand and was electrocuted.
rationale: Victim replaced conveyor motor; incorrect wiring energized frame he touched during subsequent cleaning, directly linking replacement to fatal exposure.
confirmation_rationale: The injured worker explicitly replaced the motor; faults in that installation energized the conveyor he then touched. The completed replacement is directly involved in this incident, not unrelated background.

historical_description: Align wheels.
official_description: Align wheels.

incident_quote: Consequently, he was hit in the back by the fan, pinned against the top edge of the scrap box, and killed.
rationale: The worker positioned a fan wheel on a stand and checked it, but actual alignment adjustment is not stated; no vehicle-wheel alignment is shown elsewhere.

official_description: Mop or pour hot asphalt or tar onto roof bases.

rationale: Coworkers poured hot asphalt into a mop tub held by the fatally burned worker; application onto roof bases is not yet performed in the narrative.

official_description: Pack containers and re-pack damaged containers.

rationale: Victim was loading a backhoe into an intermodal container when pinned. Packing/loading a container is evidenced but repacking damaged containers is not. Damaged refuse-container account is truncated.

incident_quote: THE MOMENTUM OF THE FALLING FRAME CARRIED EMPLOYEE #1 BACKWARDS OFF THE SCAFFOLD.
rationale: The mason was adding a third scaffold level when the frame flipped and pulled him off, explicitly showing scaffold setup.

historical_description: Retract augers to force discharge dirt from holes.
official_description: Retract augers to force discharge dirt from holes.
rationale: Feed/grain auger cleaning and relocation, bin work and lifting a digging auger to a truck are described; no retracting an auger to discharge dirt from a hole is established.

historical_description: Repair hydraulic or air pumps.

official_description: Supervise food processing or manufacturing plant operations.

rationale: Retain the conservative second-review decision after considering the third review. Agree with partial, but uncertainty is not simply lack of an eyewitness. official_description: Open and close doors for passengers.

incident_quote: BOTH EMPLOYEES WERE ADMITTED TO THE HOSPITAL AFTER FIRST AID TREATMENT AT THE SITE, SHOWING SYMPTOMS OF CHEMICAL PNEUMONIA.
rationale: The exposed elevator occupants closed and forced open the manual door during chlorine intrusion, but they acted for their own escape rather than providing passenger door service.

historical_description: Discuss work problems or grievances with union representatives.
rationale: Symptoms reported during production, exhibit removal, pesticide exposure, ship work and tanker cleaning do not establish discussion of grievances with union representatives. A union leader provides post-exposure transportation.

historical_description: Install straps, braces, and padding to loads to prevent shifting or damage during shipment.
official_description: Install straps, braces, and padding to loads to prevent shifting or damage during shipment.
rationale: Empty source plus coil unstrapping, display rack failure, manufacturing straps, and rig footing failure do not establish installing shipment straps/braces/padding.

historical_description: Assist in bus loading and unloading.
official_description: Assist in bus loading and unloading.
rationale: One injured picker was carried to a bus after a fall, with no harmed person assisting bus boarding. A wrecker operator hooked a bus for towing, not passenger loading/unloading. Other cases involve cranes, shapers, and tire unloading.

historical_description: Mediate discussions between employer and employee representatives in attempt to reconcile differences.
official_description: Mediate discussions between employer and employee representatives in attempt to reconcile differences.
rationale: Logging, concrete-form removal, cable probing, discussion of lockout with a coworker and sandblasting do not establish mediation between employer and employee representatives.

historical_description: Weld metal parts together, using portable gas welding equipment.
official_description: Weld metal parts together, using portable gas welding equipment.
activity_quote: AN EMPLOYEE WAS WELDING THE BODY OF A TRAILER TRUCK.
incident_quote: THE EMPLOYEE HAD BEEN ELECTROCUTED.
rationale: Victim welded trailer body and was electrocuted through electrode; metal joining is supported but equipment is electric arc, not portable gas welding equipment.

historical_description: Disassemble defective equipment so that repairs can be made, using hand tools.
official_description: Disassemble defective equipment so that repairs can be made, using hand tools.
rationale: Press operation, adjustment, automatic-feed setup, and tree removal do not establish disassembling defective equipment with hand tools for repair. Tool use is recommended but not performed in the press setup account.

historical_description: Position bolting machines, and insert drill bits into chucks.
official_description: Position bolting machines, and insert drill bits into chucks.
rationale: Moving a rock drill, core drilling, positioning a hand drill, grenade defusing and radial drilling do not establish bolting-machine positioning and chucking drill bits.

historical_description: Connect wires to circuit breakers, transformers, or other components.
official_description: Connect wires to circuit breakers, transformers, or other components.
activity_quote: They successfully completed installing a clip on the first phase conductor.
incident_quote: Both employees received burns to their arms and faces from the ensuing electric arc and were hospitalized for their injuries.
rationale: Electricians connected monitor clips/conductors at circuit breaker and were burned when screwdriver shorted enclosure.
confirmation_rationale: Installing the monitor connections on circuit-breaker conductors is actual electrical connection work; completing one connection then attempting the next caused the arc injury.

historical_description: Operate washing machines and dryers to clean soiled apparel and towels.
official_description: Operate washing machines and dryers to clean soiled apparel and towels.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 WAS UNLOADING A PELLERIN-MILNOR WASHER, MODEL #4-WE-300A.
incident_quote: THE TUMBLER REVOLVED, CATCHING EMPLOYEE #1 BETWEEN IT AND THE DOOR JAM.
rationale: The victim unloaded wet clothing from a washer-extractor when its drum turned, establishing washer operation. Dryer operation and towels are not evidenced in the same task activity.

historical_description: Clamp holding fixtures on ends of hoisting cables.
official_description: Clamp holding fixtures on ends of hoisting cables.
rationale: Electrical monitor clips, television cable clamping, a pigging cable shackle and grounding a light fixture do not establish clamping holding fixtures on hoisting-cable ends. Report 14382535 is empty.

historical_description: Assist in the cleanup of hazardous material spills.
official_description: Assist in the cleanup of hazardous material spills.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 WAS WASHING SPILLED DIESEL FUEL IN A YARD AREA.
incident_quote: HE COLLAPSED AND DIED FROM ACUTE PULMONARY CONGESTION AND HEMORRHAGE AND MARKED CEREBRAL EDEMA, DUE TO AN ACUTE HYPERSENSITIVITY REACTION.
rationale: Victim washed a diesel spill and collapsed fatally during cleanup; no additional coworker is required by assisting cleanup.
confirmation_rationale: The worker was cleaning spilled diesel fuel when he collapsed and died. This is incident-involved spill cleanup, not post-incident rescue.

historical_description: Construct forms or chutes for pouring concrete.
official_description: Construct forms or chutes for pouring concrete.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was laying 4-ft by 8-ft-0.75in. plywood decking on the sixth floor for pouring concrete floor.
incident_quote: Employee #1 stepped back on a 3-ft by 4 in. rib and fell 12 ft to a concrete floor, fracturing his right wrist.
rationale: The injured worker laid plywood decking as a concrete floor pouring form and fell from the support rib during this construction.
confirmation_rationale: Plywood decking placed to receive poured concrete is concrete form construction; the fall occurred during this work.

historical_description: Handle high voltage sources and hang electrical cables.
official_description: Handle high voltage sources and hang electrical cables.
activity_quote: AN EMPLOYEE WAS MOVING A CABLE TELEVISION CABLE FROM AN OLD UTILITY POLE TO A NEW ONE.
incident_quote: THE EMPLOYEE, WHO WAS APPARENTLY IN CONTACT WITH THE NEW POLE AND THE CABLE TELEVISION LINE, WAS ELECTROCUTED.
rationale: The affected worker transferred cable television cable between poles; hanging electrical power cables and handling high-voltage sources are not both established. Nearby high voltage is an exposure, not necessarily the handled object.

historical_description: Undress, wash, and dress patients who are unable to do so for themselves.
official_description: Undress, wash, and dress patients who are unable to do so for themselves.
rationale: Oil fire, sterilizer leak, truss erection, reshoring and falling storage box do not establish undressing/washing/dressing patients; hospital staff titles alone do not identify such activity.

historical_description: Operate loaders to pull out stumps, rip asphalt or concrete, rough-grade properties, bury refuse, or perform general cleanup.
official_description: Operate loaders to pull out stumps, rip asphalt or concrete, rough-grade properties, bury refuse, or perform general cleanup.

incident_quote: The bucket descended suddenly, catching and crushing his body. Employee #1 was killed.
rationale: The victim operated a Bobcat to pick up construction rubbish and was crushed while addressing plastic caught around a wheel during that cleanup.
confirmation_rationale: Loader-operated rubbish cleanup is an explicit task alternative; the worker was killed by the bucket during that operation.

historical_description: Cut, roll, and stack sod.
rationale: Stacked noodles, steel rolls, plastic sleeve processing, ingot stacking and vehicle testing contain no sod cutting, rolling or stacking.

historical_description: Drive and operate fire fighting vehicles and equipment.
official_description: Drive and operate fire fighting vehicles and equipment.

incident_quote: the fire fighters found Employee #1 slumped over the vehicle's steering wheel.
rationale: Chief arrived driving chief car to structure fire and collapsed at wheel. Fire-response vehicle operation is evidenced; firefighting equipment operation is not.

historical_description: Open and close bottom doors of cars to dump contents.
activity_quote: Evidently Employee #1, working alone and contrary to his superior's order, forced the tailgate open with a metal bar.
incident_quote: He was buried by the outflowing sand and killed.
rationale: The victim opened a truck dump-body tailgate to release sand and was buried. This supports opening a discharge gate, but it is not a car bottom door and closing is not shown.

historical_description: Test combustible appliances, such as gas appliances.
official_description: Test combustible appliances, such as gas appliances.
rationale: Floor sealing, manhole entry, asphalt-tank welding and a cigarette-triggered gas explosion do not test combustible appliances. Cooker emissions were tested after the affected production workers were treated; no tester was injured or endangered in that testing.

historical_description: Insert metal tubing through rail supports.
official_description: Insert metal tubing through rail supports.
rationale: Tub cleaning, grain dumping, overhead railway installation, handling automotive rails, and guardrail installation do not show inserting metal tubing through rail supports.

historical_description: Supervise and monitor unit nursing staff.
official_description: Supervise and monitor unit nursing staff.
rationale: Nurses respond to injured workers; a hospital security officer protects nursing staff from a knife attacker. Neither describes supervision and monitoring of unit nursing staff as incident activity.

historical_description: Operate boom trucks, loaders, stump chippers, brush chippers, tractors, power saws, trucks, sprayers, and other equipment and tools.
official_description: Operate boom trucks, loaders, stump chippers, brush chippers, tractors, power saws, trucks, sprayers, and other equipment and tools.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was operating a Manitex 1500 series boom truck crane for a tree removal service.
incident_quote: The truck overturned, crushing and killing Employee #1.
rationale: The killed worker operated a boom truck for tree removal; this supports an equipment-operation component, but the other listed equipment operations are not all evidenced in one incident.

historical_description: Drill holes along outlines, using jackhammers.
official_description: Drill holes along outlines, using jackhammers.
rationale: Reshoring, portable electric drilling, drilling-rig pipe handling/testing, and pallet drilling do not show jackhammer holes along outlines.

historical_description: Erect ladders and scaffolding to fit together large assemblies.
official_description: Erect ladders and scaffolding to fit together large assemblies.

incident_quote: A PORTION OF THE WALL FELL WITH PART OF IT LANDING ON EMPLOYEE #1.
rationale: The laborer unloaded scaffold parts in preparation for erection and was struck by a wall pushed over by the forklift. Actual erection of ladders and scaffolding for fitting large assemblies is not shown.

historical_description: Post warning signs on vehicles containing explosives or flammable or radioactive materials.
official_description: Post warning signs on vehicles containing explosives or flammable or radioactive materials.
rationale: Tank painting, explosive-contaminated pipe shearing, tanker explosions, electrical sign repair and acid storage exposure contain no posting of hazardous-cargo warning signs on vehicles.

historical_description: Give directions to other workers regarding machine set-up and use.
official_description: Give directions to other workers regarding machine set-up and use.

incident_quote: WHEN THE MACHINE STARTED, HE WAS CAUGHT AND CRUSHED BETWEEN MOVING PARTS.
rationale: Victim directed coworker to start stacker for oiling and was crushed. Machine-use direction is explicit; machine setup direction is not.

historical_description: Heat-treat parts, using acetylene torches.

historical_description: Precast terrazzo blocks in wooden forms.
official_description: Precast terrazzo blocks in wooden forms.
rationale: Plastering, roofing, receiving doors, ceiling installation and vault cement chipping use planks or wooden structures but do not precast terrazzo blocks in forms.

historical_description: Remove foreign bodies from the eye.
official_description: Remove foreign bodies from the eye.
rationale: Eye injuries from nailing/mowing, beam fall, worn sling eyes and electric-eye troubleshooting do not establish removing foreign bodies from an eye.

historical_description: Repair or replace damaged equipment.
official_description: Repair or replace damaged equipment.

incident_quote: HE WAS THROWN INTO THE PATH OF THE RIGHT TRACK, RUN OVER, AND CRUSHED.
rationale: The victim attempted repair of a broken drum line, then carried it while boarding the dozer; that line released the brake and caused the fatal runover.
confirmation_rationale: Actual attempted repair of the broken drum line is reported, followed by moving that broken line while boarding the machine. Its contact with the brake release initiated the fatal sequence. Unsuccessful repair remains performed activity; the report reconstructs the incident from evidence.

historical_description: Place articles to be stripped into stripping tanks.
official_description: Place articles to be stripped into stripping tanks.
rationale: Tank dismantling, metal-strip press operation, tanker valve repair, punch-press clearing and retrieving an article from a pit contain no loading articles into stripping tanks.

historical_description: Attach roofing paper and composition shingles, using nails.
official_description: Attach roofing paper and composition shingles, using nails.

incident_quote: THEY BOTH FELL 24 FEET TO THE GROUND AND WERE HOSPITALIZED.
rationale: Crew installed felt paper, with victim clearing snowy roof as part of that work. Composition shingles and attachment with nails are unconfirmed; roof was intended for metal covering.

historical_description: Cover surfaces with laminated plastic covering material.
official_description: Cover surfaces with laminated plastic covering material.
rationale: Plastic sheets and domes are existing coverings during stain removal or roof work, not laminated-plastic application by an involved worker. Other cases involve equipment movement or grain maintenance.

historical_description: Stock shelves with products.
official_description: Stock shelves with products.
