incident_quote: The employee was struck in the right eye by leaking corrosive material.
rationale: The injured worker was restocking a shelf with batteries and handling the stock when corrosive material splashed his eye.
confirmation_rationale: Restocking batteries on a shelf is explicit; handling a damaged battery in that process caused an eye burn. The split brand name does not change the action.

historical_description: Notify facility personnel of equipment shutdowns.
official_description: Notify facility personnel of equipment shutdowns.
rationale: Warning tape at removed stairs, shredder unjamming, spill/leak warnings and injured worker requesting shutdown do not establish notification of equipment shutdowns. First account truncated before injury.

historical_description: Unload finished products from conveyor belts, pack them in containers, and place containers in warehouses.
official_description: Unload finished products from conveyor belts, pack them in containers, and place containers in warehouses.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was sending plastic hardware products in cardboard containers from the first level storeroom up an inclined, fabric-belted, mechanically driven conveyor through a wall opening to the second level storeroom.
incident_quote: The approximately 15 lb container, which measured 23 in. high by 20 in. wide by 17 in. long, continued to rise and struck Employee #1, lodging against his throat. He died of asphyxia.
rationale: The worker conveyed boxed hardware between storerooms and accessed the unloading area; packing finished products into containers is not stated, and the unwitnessed sequence is explicitly conjectural.

historical_description: Conduct exit interviews to identify reasons for employee termination.
rationale: Escaping an electrical fire, bin cleaning/rescue, trench-exit warnings and a supervisor exiting a press do not establish employment exit interviews.

historical_description: Repair leaks with caulking compound or replace pipes, using pipe wrenches.
official_description: Repair leaks with caulking compound or replace pipes, using pipe wrenches.
activity_quote: HE WAS REPAIRING A LEAK BY TIGHTENING BOLTS ON A SLEEVE ON AN 8-INCH GAS MAIN.
incident_quote: STRUCK THE EMPLOYEE, WHO SUSTAINED A BROKEN PELVIS, BACK AND INTERNAL INJURIES.
rationale: Victim repaired a gas-main leak by tightening sleeve bolts and was struck by displaced pipe. Leak repair is established but caulking or replacement with pipe wrenches is not.

historical_description: Dig out sewer lines manually, using shovels.
official_description: Dig out sewer lines manually, using shovels.
activity_quote: HE WAS MANUALLY REMOVING SLUDGE BY LOADING IT INTO BUCKETS WITH A SHOVEL.
incident_quote: HE SAW EMPLOYEE #2 STAGGER IN THE TANK AND THEN FALL OVER INTO THE SLUDGE.
rationale: The affected worker manually shoveled sludge from a clarifier tank. This establishes manual shovel removal of material but not digging out sewer lines; other cases involve pipe connections or gravel spreading.

historical_description: Perform general labor duties such as repairing booms.
official_description: Perform general labor duties such as repairing booms.
activity_quote: Employee #2 was on the barge arranging the rigging to hook up the template to the crane's two wire rope lifting cables.
incident_quote: Employee #2 was knocked into the river by a cable that whipped across the barge when the boom collapsed.
rationale: Arranging crane rigging is a general labor duty directly performed by the worker injured when the boom collapsed; boom repair is an illustrative example rather than a required action.
confirmation_rationale: Rigging a load is performed general labor and the rigging worker was injured by the collapsing crane. The task says such as repairing booms, an illustrative example; no boom repair is asserted here. This broad task warrants a granularity caveat.

historical_description: Tend conveyor chains that move logs to and from scaling stations.
activity_quote: It appears that Employee #1 had tried to kick a hung-up log to get it loose but his foot was caught in the fast-moving log conveyor chain.
incident_quote: Employee #1 suffered a severely crushed foot/ankle and lower leg;
rationale: Victim apparently freed a hung-up log on fast-moving logfeed chain and was entrapped. Log conveyor tending is supported; transport to/from scaling stations is unconfirmed.

historical_description: Clean and maintain equipment, using water hoses and scrapers.
official_description: Clean and maintain equipment, using water hoses and scrapers.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 INSERTED THE NOZZLE INTO THE PIPE IN THE VALVE BOX AND SIGNALED FOR WATER. WATER UNDER PRESSURE WAS APPLIED.
incident_quote: THE CLEANING GUN STRUCK EMPLOYEE # 1 ON THE TEMPLE, INFLICTING A FATAL INJURY.
rationale: The sewer worker cleaned a valve box with a high-pressure gun and hose and was fatally struck by it. Scraper use and the complete cleaning-and-maintenance combination are not established.

historical_description: Level washing machines and connect hoses to water pipes, using hand tools.
official_description: Level washing machines and connect hoses to water pipes, using hand tools.
activity_quote: AN EMPLOYEE WAS INSTALLING A SOAP AND WATER LINE ON A SHACKLE WASHER ABOVE A LINE IN THE CUT UP DEPARTMENT OF A CHICKEN PROCESSING PLANT.
incident_quote: THE LIGHTING FIXTURE HAD A GROUND FAULT, AND THE EMPLOYEE RECEIVED AN ELECTRIC SHOCK.
rationale: The affected employee installed a water line on a shackle washer, but leveling a washing machine, hose connection and hand tools are not established.

historical_description: Direct the casting of the concrete and supervise laborers who use shovels or special tools to spread it.
official_description: Direct the casting of the concrete and supervise laborers who use shovels or special tools to spread it.
rationale: Concrete pumping with nozzle/boom controls, pile cutting/setting, demolition and cable installation show no supervising laborers spreading cast concrete.

historical_description: Inflate inner tubes and immerse them in water to locate leaks.
official_description: Inflate inner tubes and immerse them in water to locate leaks.
activity_quote: THE TIRE WAS INFLATED AND AIR WAS HEARD LEAKING OUT.
incident_quote: THE TIRE EXPLODED, KNOCKING EMPLOYEE #1 SIX FEET BACKWARDS. HE FELL AND WAS KILLED WHEN HE STRUCK HIS HEAD ON A MULTIPIECE RIM LYING ON THE FLOOR.
rationale: The victim inflated and checked a leaking tire before explosion, but no inner-tube immersion in water is described. Cooling a welded rim with a hose in the other tire case is not immersion.

historical_description: Lift or move materials and finished products, using large cranes.
official_description: Lift or move materials and finished products, using large cranes.
activity_quote: ON THE FIRST LIFT, THE CRANE WAS LIFTING 6 SHEETS OF PLYWOOD
incident_quote: THE CRANE TIPPED OVER TOWARD THE EXCAVATION. THE OPERATOR JUMPED FREE AND WAS NOT INJURED.
rationale: A 35-ton crane lifted plywood and overturned, directly endangering its operator, who jumped clear. Injury is not necessary where an accident during the activity is explicit.
confirmation_rationale: A 35-ton crane lifted manufactured plywood sheets and tipped over in that operation. This establishes an accident-associated material/finished-product lift, explicitly without an injury to this operator.

historical_description: Reassemble machines after making repairs or replacing parts.
official_description: Reassemble machines after making repairs or replacing parts.
activity_quote: A PAPER MACHINE BREAST ROLL ASSEMBLY WAS BEING REINSTALLED ON A PAPER MACHINE.
incident_quote: HE WAS CRUSHED TO DEATH.
rationale: Breast-roll assembly was being reinstalled when it crushed engineer measuring obstruction. Reassembly is explicit, but preceding repair or parts replacement is unstated.

historical_description: Operate controls to move or discharge metal workpieces from furnaces.
official_description: Operate controls to move or discharge metal workpieces from furnaces.
rationale: Converter charging puts material into a furnace, not discharging metal workpieces from it. Pressing cold metal, roofing, aerial-lift operation, and investigating furnace emissions also do not show the specified controls activity.

historical_description: Cut and peel lead sheathing and insulation from defective or newly installed cables and conduits prior to splicing.
official_description: Cut and peel lead sheathing and insulation from defective or newly installed cables and conduits prior to splicing.
activity_quote: THE CORD SET HAD BEEN CUT, AND THE CIRCUIT CONDUCTOR WERE STRIPPED TO FACILITATE CONNECTING THE CORD TO THE MOTOR.
incident_quote: HE HAD BEEN ELECTROCUTED, APPARENTLY THROUGH CONTACT WITH THE EXPOSED ENERGIZED PARTS.
rationale: A stripped cord was connected to a motor for testing and its bare energized parts apparently killed the tester. Insulation stripping is evidenced in the setup, but the actor who stripped it and lead sheathing or defective/new cable qualifications are not established.

historical_description: Sharpen blades, or replace defective or worn blades or bands, using hand tools.
official_description: Sharpen blades, or replace defective or worn blades or bands, using hand tools.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was replacing the old knives in an RA#2 envelope machine.
incident_quote: the rotating knives amputated the tip of his right index finger.
rationale: Victim replaced old envelope-machine knives and tested alignment, amputating finger. Defect/wear and use of hand tools are not stated.

historical_description: Cut timbers, lumber, or paneling to specified dimensions.
official_description: Cut timbers, lumber, or paneling to specified dimensions.
activity_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 WAS OPERATING A TABLE SAW, CUTTING PLYWOOD PANELS TO SIZE.
incident_quote: A PIECE OF SCRAP WOOD PULLED HIS RIGHT HAND INTO THE BLADE, RESULTING IN THE AMPUTATION OF THE MIDDLE FINGER OF HIS RIGHT HAND AT THE FIRST JOINT.
rationale: The injured saw operator explicitly cut plywood panels to size. One other report is empty.
confirmation_rationale: Cutting plywood panels to size is explicit dimensioned panel cutting and directly produced a hand injury.

historical_description: Replace defective parts of machine, or adjust clearances and alignment of moving parts.
official_description: Replace defective parts of machine, or adjust clearances and alignment of moving parts.
activity_quote: HE DECIDED TO REMOVE THE ELEVATOR MOTOR.
incident_quote: BY REMOVING THE MOTOR, THE ELEVATOR WAS FREED AND FELL ONTO EMPLOYEE #1, KILLING HIM.
rationale: Removing an elevator motor to investigate a malfunction is a replacement-related repair component, but actual replacement of a defective part or adjustment of alignment/clearance is not established.

historical_description: Press buttons to activate cleaning equipment or machines.
official_description: Press buttons to activate cleaning equipment or machines.
activity_quote: After he finished cleaning, he leaned over and hit the equipment safety button.
incident_quote: The machine activated, trapping his legs in the pinch point at the base.
rationale: Victim hit machine button following mold cleaning; activation trapped his legs. Activation by button is explicit.
confirmation_rationale: He pressed the machine button and the machine activated, injuring his leg. Acceptance uses the literal machines alternative; the machine manufactures molds and is not itself asserted to be a dedicated cleaning machine. Task wording is broad and interpretation should be audited.

historical_description: Locate worn or torn areas in roofs.
official_description: Locate worn or torn areas in roofs.
rationale: Reports describe painting, roof cleanup, toilet use beneath a steam rupture, a gas-holder explosion, and a roofer found dead from heat. No worker locates worn or torn roof areas.

historical_description: Roughen surfaces of fingernails, using abrasive wheel.
official_description: Roughen surfaces of fingernails, using abrasive wheel.
rationale: Press cleaning, cup-machine operation, stone demolding, meat grinding and packaging injuries affect fingers/nails; none roughens fingernails with an abrasive wheel.

historical_description: Remove completed workpieces or parts from machinery, using hand tools.
official_description: Remove completed workpieces or parts from machinery, using hand tools.
activity_quote: As she removed a part, the press reportedly cycled and caught her fingers in the die area.
incident_quote: Three fingers on her right hand were amputated.
rationale: Victim removed formed bracket from press and suffered amputations. Removal is explicit, but it was by hand rather than using hand tools.

historical_description: Raise rails, using hydraulic jacks, to allow for tie removal and replacement.
official_description: Raise rails, using hydraulic jacks, to allow for tie removal and replacement.
activity_quote: Employees #1 and #2 and a coworker were attempting to relocate elevator guide rails. Employee #1 was operating two 6 ton coffin chain hoists at the 18 1/2 floor level.
incident_quote: The 3/8 in. wire rope sheared, allowing the rails to fall. Employee #1 suffered internal bruises and Employee #2 suffered a hand injury.
rationale: Workers hoisted and relocated elevator guide rails, supporting rail lifting only. These are not railway rails lifted by hydraulic jacks to replace ties.

historical_description: Load and unload items from machines, conveyors, and conveyances.
official_description: Load and unload items from machines, conveyors, and conveyances.
activity_quote: THE EMPLOYEES WERE UNLOADING A TRUCK AND MANUALLY PLACING THE MERCHANDISE ONTO A ROLLER-TYPE CONVEYOR (BELT DRIVEN).
incident_quote: SOME OF THE BOTTLES BROKE, RELEASING HARMFUL VAPORS INTO THE WORKPLACE.
rationale: The affected employees unloaded goods from a truck and loaded them onto a conveyor; pushing those goods caused a chemical spill and exposure. These are the task's unloading/loading actions across conveyance and conveyor.
confirmation_rationale: The workers unloaded the truck and loaded a conveyor; a package fell during that work, releasing fumes and sending five exposed workers to hospitals for observation.

historical_description: Trim lumber to straighten rough edges or remove defects, using circular saws.
official_description: Trim lumber to straighten rough edges or remove defects, using circular saws.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was reripping a 1/4 in. by 12 in. piece of wood on a circular hand-fed rip saw.
incident_quote: Three of his fingers and his thumb were severely lacerated.
rationale: Victim reripped lumber using circular saw and cut fingers; trimming to straighten rough edges/remove defects is not specified.

historical_description: Communicate geothermal plant conditions to employees.
official_description: Communicate geothermal plant conditions to employees.
rationale: Ice-cream ammonia release, boiler repair, tank warming, electrical-tool complaints, and roof-hole preparation are described. No geothermal plant conditions are communicated to employees.

historical_description: Mow or edge lawns, using power mowers or edgers.
official_description: Mow or edge lawns, using power mowers or edgers.
activity_quote: He was cutting grass at the side of a house
incident_quote: The mower then ran over his foot, amputating his big toe.
rationale: The affected lawn-service worker cut residential grass using a riding power mower that threw and ran over him. Report 170081921 is empty.
confirmation_rationale: Actual power mowing of a residential lawn is explicit; brake lockup threw the worker and the mower amputated his toe.

historical_description: Change worn cutting tools, using wrenches.
official_description: Change worn cutting tools, using wrenches.

incident_quote: the employee's finger was crushed between the bit bar and the solid cross bar of the machine.
rationale: Victim changed drill bits and was crushed when machine actuated. Wear and wrench use are unstated.

historical_description: Cut and bind material.
official_description: Cut and bind material.
adjudication_rationale: Retain the conservative second-review decision after considering the third review. Agree with partial under the performed-action rule. Binding shorts is performed, but material cutting is only described as the machine's general function; the observed knife cycle cuts her hand. The conjunctive task needs both material cutting and binding, not capability alone.
activity_quote: an employee was operating a sewing machine that attaches bind ing to shorts.
incident_quote: she accidentally hit the pedal resulting in the knife cutting across the hand and injuring it.
rationale: Retain the conservative second-review decision after considering the third review. Agree with partial under the performed-action rule. Binding shorts is performed, but material cutting is only described as the machine's general function; the observed knife cycle cuts her hand. The conjunctive task needs both material cutting and binding, not capability alone.
confirmation_rationale: Binding is supported, but the knife description states capability/use in general and the observed cut is to a hand, not material. Other inspected reports establish wood/tree cutting without binding, or unrelated handling. Both material cutting AND binding are not explicitly established in a single incident activity.

historical_description: Install dock seals, bumpers, or shelters.
official_description: Install dock seals, bumpers, or shelters.

historical_description: Drive trucks to transport high-pressure pumping equipment, and chemicals, fluids, or gases to be pumped into wells.

historical_description: Install vapor barriers or layers of insulation on flat roofs.

historical_description: Dig trenches for underground wires or cables.

historical_description: Operate conveyors and equipment to transfer grain or other materials from transportation vehicles.
official_description: Operate conveyors and equipment to transfer grain or other materials from transportation vehicles.

historical_description: Align, level, and anchor machinery.
official_description: Align, level, and anchor machinery.

historical_description: Design or implement plans for structural demolition and debris removal.

historical_description: Refuel and lubricate engines.
official_description: Refuel and lubricate engines.

historical_description: Hammer loose staples for proper attachment.

rationale: Nailing form lumber, crane-line spooling, concrete-unit rigging, conveyor clearing, and marble rearrangement do not establish hammering loose staples.

historical_description: Drive vehicles equipped with tools and materials to job sites.

rationale: Crew traveled in truck used to carry tools/materials when standing passenger fell out. Driving is direct exposure but destination at a jobsite is not stated.

official_description: Perform first aid or cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) when required.

historical_description: Visually inspect cargo for damage upon arrival or discharge.
official_description: Visually inspect cargo for damage upon arrival or discharge.
rationale: Truck hauling, yard-hustler driving, dock drain cleaning, roofing and van-liner spraying contain no cargo-damage inspection at arrival or discharge.

historical_description: Climb poles and ladders, use truck-mounted booms, and enter areas such as manholes and cable vaults to install, maintain, or inspect equipment.

historical_description: Cut or drill holes in walls or floors to accommodate the passage of pipes.
official_description: Cut or drill holes in walls or floors to accommodate the passage of pipes.

confirmation_rationale: The plumber opened a hole in a manhole wall to install a sanitary pipe; the surrounding trench collapsed during that task and killed him.

historical_description: Remove and replace tank car dome caps, or direct other workers in their removal and replacement.
official_description: Remove and replace tank car dome caps, or direct other workers in their removal and replacement.
rationale: Tank cleaning rescue, dip-tank retrieval, donning an air tank, car gas-tank removal and storage-tank vent-pipe replacement do not remove and replace tank-car dome caps.

historical_description: Open safe locks by drilling.
official_description: Open safe locks by drilling.
rationale: Zinc spinning, planing, tower descent, ripsaw operation and drill-collar hoisting show no drilling safe locks.

historical_description: Work with or remove hazardous material.
official_description: Work with or remove hazardous material.

historical_description: Warn troublemakers causing problems on establishment premises and eject them from premises when necessary.
rationale: Tank entry, saw off-bearing, building collapse escape and a trench cave-in warning contain no warning/ejection of troublemakers. Report 1001908 is empty.

historical_description: Remove items from washers or dry-cleaning machines, or direct other workers to do so.
official_description: Remove items from washers or dry-cleaning machines, or direct other workers to do so.
rationale: Auger removal, electrical cable repair, machine disassembly/resale, pressure washing tanks and grain explosion do not show removing items from washers or dry-cleaning machines.

official_description: Operate slicing or wrapping machines.

confirmation_rationale: The operator actually jogged the cheese-wrapping machine while threading/feeding it; rotating crimpers amputated fingertips.

historical_description: Prepare inserts, heel pads, and lifts from casts of customers' feet.
official_description: Prepare inserts, heel pads, and lifts from casts of customers' feet.

historical_description: Restock storage areas, replenishing items on shelves.
official_description: Restock storage areas, replenishing items on shelves.
rationale: Tank welding, staging pallet, retrieving stored boxes/merchandise and storage-room caulking show no shelf replenishment. Placement in staging area does not establish restocking shelves.

historical_description: Apply protective or injury preventive devices, such as tape, bandages, or braces, to body parts, such as ankles, fingers, or wrists.
official_description: Apply protective or injury preventive devices, such as tape, bandages, or braces, to body parts, such as ankles, fingers, or wrists.
rationale: Wrist, finger, hip, ankle, and leg injuries arise from falls, press operation, cargo, brake work, and chainsaw use. Protective devices being absent or injury locations do not establish applying tape, bandages, or braces.

historical_description: Attach sheets of metal to roof boards or building frameworks when installing metal roofs.
official_description: Attach sheets of metal to roof boards or building frameworks when installing metal roofs.

historical_description: Lower irons, rams, or pressing heads of machines into position over material to be pressed.
official_description: Lower irons, rams, or pressing heads of machines into position over material to be pressed.

confirmation_rationale: The worker activated a press brake by foot trip while bending metal; the forming action amputated his finger. This supports lowering a pressing head over material.

historical_description: Repair, maintain, and adjust equipment, using hand tools.
official_description: Repair, maintain, and adjust equipment, using hand tools.

rationale: The service technician used a pipe wrench to attach a drilling reamer and was struck when it spun. Equipment setup/service using a hand tool is evidenced, but repair, maintenance, and adjustment collectively are not. One source is empty.

historical_description: Grade or level trench bases, using tamping machines or hand tools.
official_description: Grade or level trench bases, using tamping machines or hand tools.

rationale: A grade-man responsible for trench depth and leveling dug around an uncovered line and was buried; the actual tool and performed base-leveling action are not explicitly identified.

historical_description: Operate heavy equipment, such as bulldozers and front-end loaders.
official_description: Operate heavy equipment, such as bulldozers and front-end loaders.

rationale: Loader operator applied wrong brakes during grading, pivoting bucket into nearby superintendent.
confirmation_rationale: The loader was actively grading and its operator applied the wrong brakes; the bucket pivoted and fatally pinned the superintendent.

historical_description: Maintain production equipment and machinery.
official_description: Maintain production equipment and machinery.

confirmation_rationale: A stronger source explicitly states maintenance with machinery locked out on an industrial cooker; rotating its shaft with channel locks amputated part of a finger. This supports production-equipment maintenance.

historical_description: Position stock in furnaces, using tongs, chain hoists, or pry bars.
official_description: Position stock in furnaces, using tongs, chain hoists, or pry bars.
rationale: Stacker setup, furnace training, strip rewinding, switch testing and ash buildup inspection do not position stock inside furnaces with tongs, chain hoists or pry bars.

historical_description: Cut flooring material to fit around obstructions.

official_description: Direct and transport workers to appropriate work sites.

rationale: A supervisor directed electrical workers in their grounding and switching work directly related to the electrocution, but transporting workers to sites is not established.

incident_quote: its boom contacted the power line, electrocuting the employee at the controls.
rationale: Worker operated rock-drill boom controls and was electrocuted. Raising drill boom is evidenced but raising a derrick or leveling rig specifically is not.

historical_description: Bore boltholes in timber, masonry or concrete walls, using power drill.
official_description: Bore boltholes in timber, masonry or concrete walls, using power drill.

rationale: The injured worker drilled a hole in a concrete beam. Its purpose as a bolthole, the use of a power drill, and a wall rather than beam are not stated.

historical_description: Supervise the activities of housekeeping personnel.

rationale: A housekeeping supervisor performs vacuuming himself; another helps an elevator occupant after a breakdown. Neither establishes supervising housekeeping work as the incident activity. Other examples involve siding, chemical exposure and drywall scaffold movement.

rationale: Routine press maintenance and servicing are explicit and the worker was injured cleaning its rollers. Repair activity is not independently established in these examples.

historical_description: Coordinate dismantling, moving, and setting up equipment at new work sites.

rationale: The affected mechanic coordinated with a removal company and prepared dismantled machine equipment for moving; setting equipment up at new worksites is not established.

official_description: Greet customers and open their car doors.
rationale: Exiting energized truck, personal car ignition, foundry furnace loading, dairy loading and truck maintenance show no customer greeting or opening their car doors.

official_description: Set up equipment and prepare medical treatment rooms.
rationale: Medical treatment follows concrete-trowel fumes, table-saw cuts, shredding, paper-roll handling, and welding burns. No one sets up equipment and prepares medical treatment rooms as an eligible activity.

official_description: Operate lifts, winches, or chain falls to move heavy curtain doors.

rationale: The affected mechanic used a hydraulic winch to lift a transmission; moving heavy curtain doors is not established. Other cases move trusses/castings or handle doors without the specified lifting equipment; 691386 is truncated.

rationale: Monorail cleaning, sand unbridging, removing already-jammed cartons, logging rigging and metal plate handling show no monitoring forming-machine cartons through rotating hoppers/gravity chutes to prevent jams.

confirmation_rationale: Setting up temporary concrete forms and decking with scaffold shoring supports the other-installation-structures alternative; a decking strip failed and the worker fell fatally.

historical_description: Supervise crews in cleaning or maintaining decks, superstructures, or bridges.
official_description: Supervise crews in cleaning or maintaining decks, superstructures, or bridges.

incident_quote: the platform suddenly collapsed and fell 40 ft with the bucket and Employee #1 into the river.
rationale: The foreman coordinated crane pickup of bridge demolition debris during the fatal platform collapse; cleaning/maintenance rather than demolition replacement is not firmly established.

official_description: Clean and maintain equipment, using hand tools.

incident_quote: he sustained an open fracture of his left hand and index finger.
rationale: Victim cleaned and serviced hydraulic-press mold plate and fractured hand. Both actions are explicit; hand tools are not stated.

official_description: Control hoists to remove parts or products from work stations.

rationale: The crew controlled a power hoist lowering equipment from a roof and the frame fell with the foreman. Removing parts or products from work stations is not specified.

confirmation_rationale: The worker arranged material on the powered conveyor and was caught when it closed. The description supports direct manual adjustment in context; the specific implement is not separately named.

historical_description: Report any mechanical problems encountered with vehicles.
official_description: Report any mechanical problems encountered with vehicles.
rationale: Vehicle slides/collisions, bucket release, sanitation truck runaway and crawling under truck show no reporting vehicle mechanical problems. Post-event investigative statements are not incident activity.

official_description: Clean and wash rigs, ambulances, or equipment.

incident_quote: WHEN HE TURNED ON THE ELECTRIC POWER, HE WAS ELECTROCUTED.

confirmation_rationale: The worker scrubbed the rig with soap and picked up its wash-down nozzle, then was electrocuted when powering the pump. Both cleaning and washing activity are represented.

historical_description: Monitor pumps and flow lines for gas and fluid leaks.
official_description: Monitor pumps and flow lines for gas and fluid leaks.

historical_description: Staple sides of shoes, pressing a foot treadle to position and hold each shoe under the feeder of the machine.
official_description: Staple sides of shoes, pressing a foot treadle to position and hold each shoe under the feeder of the machine.
rationale: Metal pressing, carrot cutting, printer cleaning and dust-collector work do not show shoe-side stapling.

historical_description: Drive moving equipment to transport materials and parts to excavation sites.

incident_quote: The truck continued down a steep embankment, and Employee #1 was ejected from the truck. Employee #1 was killed.
rationale: The driver was traveling to collect drill steel for another drilling site and was killed when the truck rolled back. Equipment transport purpose is indicated, but he had not yet collected the load, and an excavation destination is unspecified.

historical_description: Move pipes to and from trucks, using truck winches and motorized lifts, or by hand.

confirmation_rationale: A truck winched a pipe-filled basket onto its bed; shifting of that load caused a rack to crush the swamper. Truck-winch pipe movement is directly involved.

historical_description: Clean and organize work area and disinfect equipment after treatment.
official_description: Clean and organize work area and disinfect equipment after treatment.

rationale: Victim scrubbed processing equipment as coworkers sanitized it and was strangled by apron caught on conveyor. Cleaning component is supported; work-area organization and after-treatment context are not.

historical_description: Hammer out bulges or bends in metal workpieces.

rationale: Beam unloading, a mill projectile, electrical switching, billet hoisting, and lathe turning do not establish hammering bulges or bends out of metal.

historical_description: Control traffic passing near, in, or around work zones.
official_description: Control traffic passing near, in, or around work zones.

incident_quote: It struck several barrels along the right hand lane and then struck Employee #1, killing him.

confirmation_rationale: Workers actively straightened markers diverting highway traffic around paving work; a passing truck struck and killed one. Device-based traffic control qualifies without hand signalling.

historical_description: Reassemble and test equipment after repairs.
official_description: Reassemble and test equipment after repairs.

incident_quote: EMPLOYEE #1 SUSTAINED SERIOUS BACK AND ABDOMINAL INJURIES WHEN HE WAS CRUSHED AT THE POINT OF IMPACT BETWEEN THE TWO MACHINES.
rationale: Improper hydraulic hose reconnection after temporary repair directly reversed machine response and caused crushing. Reassembly is supported but testing after repair is not. One source is administrative complaint text rather than injury narrative.

historical_description: Test repaired items to ensure proper operation.
official_description: Test repaired items to ensure proper operation.
rationale: Reports show tool use, restarting a press while its repairman remained inside, attic wiring, doorsill replacement, and chipper feeding. The chipper stop test is post-event; no affected worker tests a repaired item for proper operation.

historical_description: Use masks, gloves, and safety glasses to protect patients and self from infectious diseases.
official_description: Use masks, gloves, and safety glasses to protect patients and self from infectious diseases.

rationale: Ladder ropes, offshore anchoring, scaffold rigging, beam lowering and dredger recovery do not establish mooring vessels to bitts on lock decks or wharfs.

historical_description: Set up employee work schedules.
official_description: Set up employee work schedules.
rationale: Shift changes, work arrival and cutting/rest intervals describe schedules or actions without an endangered actor setting employee work schedules. Management's stop-work instruction after CO symptoms is not scheduling.

historical_description: Lubricate workpieces with oil.
official_description: Lubricate workpieces with oil.
rationale: Oil is added to a sewing machine, handled for machine lubrication or used in food preparation. An oily welding workpiece is described, but no eligible actor applies lubricating oil to a workpiece.

historical_description: Repair breaks in percussion instruments, such as drums and cymbals, using drill presses, power saws, glue, clamps, grinding wheels, or other hand tools.
rationale: Storage drums, grinding drums, textile drums, concrete-mixer cleaning and bulldozer line repair are not percussion-instrument repair.

historical_description: Cut or drill holes in floors, walls, or roof to install equipment, using power saws or drills.
official_description: Cut or drill holes in floors, walls, or roof to install equipment, using power saws or drills.
activity_quote: was working on the upper roof deck of a building, cutting holes in the metal deck for HVAC equipment.
incident_quote: The employee sustained multiple broken bones and a punctured lung.
rationale: Roofer cut metal-roof holes for HVAC equipment with a battery saw, then fell through the cut section.
confirmation_rationale: Battery-powered roof-deck cutting for HVAC installation is explicit. After fetching a battery the employee falls through the very cut being made, directly linking this equipment-installation opening to the injury.

historical_description: Ride on moving cars by holding onto grab irons and standing on ladder steps.
official_description: Ride on moving cars by holding onto grab irons and standing on ladder steps.
activity_quote: Exiting the top deck, he was holding the metal handle on the inside of the car while moving to grab the outside handle and descend the railcar ladder.
incident_quote: He fell approximately 15 ft to the ground and was hospitalized.
rationale: The affected worker held railcar handles while moving to descend its ladder. Riding a moving car while standing on ladder steps is not established; the task was preparing to unload vehicles.

historical_description: Deposit recoverable materials into chutes or place materials on conveyor belts.
official_description: Deposit recoverable materials into chutes or place materials on conveyor belts.
rationale: Bottle-machine troubleshooting, conveyor cleaning, almond sorting, scaffold travel and drugstore goods transport do not establish depositing recoverable materials in chutes or onto belts.

historical_description: Couple air and gas lines to machines to maintain plasticity of material and to regulate solidification of final products.
official_description: Couple air and gas lines to machines to maintain plasticity of material and to regulate solidification of final products.
activity_quote: Employee #1, initially in the control room, proceeded to the ground level to open a valve on the reactor slurry line to prevent solidification.
incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained burns to his arms and was hospitalized for treatment.
rationale: Worker opened a reactor slurry valve to prevent solidification and was scalded when steam was admitted; coupling air/gas lines and regulating finished-product solidification are not shown.

historical_description: Secure cargo for transport, using ropes, blocks, chain, binders, or covers.
official_description: Secure cargo for transport, using ropes, blocks, chain, binders, or covers.
activity_quote: Chains were placed to secure the loader with a chain binder.
incident_quote: the chain binder handle collapsed and hit him in the throat.
rationale: The affected driver secured a loader with chains and a binder and was injured during the final inspection when the binder handle collapsed.
confirmation_rationale: Chain-and-binder securing of the truck load is explicit. The binder from that secured load collapses onto the driver during his final inspection.

historical_description: Saw, split, or scribe carcasses into smaller portions to facilitate handling.
official_description: Saw, split, or scribe carcasses into smaller portions to facilitate handling.
activity_quote: Employee #1 started to cut the steak approximately ten ins. by ten ins. by ten ins. in dimension.
incident_quote: Employee #1 was then hospitalized and treated for an amputated finger.
rationale: The affected worker sawed a steak into smaller pieces, but subdividing carcasses specifically to facilitate handling is not established.

historical_description: Stop machines to remove completed components, using hand tools.
official_description: Stop machines to remove completed components, using hand tools.

incident_quote: The finger was amputated to the first joint, but the employee was not hospitalized.
rationale: Worker removed a discharged cardboard tray, but did so while the machine ran and by hand rather than stopping it and using tools.

historical_description: Slice fruits, vegetables, desserts, or meats for use in food service.
official_description: Slice fruits, vegetables, desserts, or meats for use in food service.

incident_quote: the blade was still turning with enough force to amputate his right index finger at the first knuckle.
rationale: The affected restaurant cook cut tomatoes for sauce with a food chopper and was injured clearing residual tomato immediately afterward.
confirmation_rationale: The cook cuts tomatoes into small pieces for sauce using a powered chopper; residual blade rotation amputates a finger while he clears remaining tomato immediately after processing.

historical_description: Inspect electrical connections, wiring, relays, charging resistance boxes, and storage batteries, following wiring diagrams.
official_description: Inspect electrical connections, wiring, relays, charging resistance boxes, and storage batteries, following wiring diagrams.

incident_quote: THE EMPLOYEE CONTACTED ENERGIZED PARTS OF THE LIGHTING CIRCUIT AND WAS ELECTROCUTED.
rationale: The affected worker checked lighting wiring connections, but inspection of relays, resistance boxes and batteries following diagrams is absent.

historical_description: Lubricate door closer oil chambers, and pack spindles with leather washers.
official_description: Lubricate door closer oil chambers, and pack spindles with leather washers.
rationale: Lubricating mixer gears, cooking-oil handling and autoclave door failure do not show door-closer oil-chamber lubrication or packing spindles with leather washers.

historical_description: Inspect loads to ensure that cargo is secure.
official_description: Inspect loads to ensure that cargo is secure.
activity_quote: The employee pulled over to the side of the highway to perform the required load check and, for unknown reasons, unsecured both cargo straps that held the panes of glass to the trailer.
incident_quote: The employee died of multiple fractures, lacerations, and punctures from the impact of the falling glass and impact with the ground.
rationale: The affected driver stopped for a required cargo check and released the securing straps during it; unsecured glass then fell on him.
confirmation_rationale: The driver stops for the required cargo-security check and releases securing straps; the unsecured glass falls and kills him. The report does not explain why he released them.

historical_description: Mount, balance, change, or check condition or pressure of tires.
official_description: Mount, balance, change, or check condition or pressure of tires.

incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained major lacerations to his right leg and an amputation of his right little finger.
rationale: The affected mechanic checked tire pressure with a gauge while filling it, then the tire exploded.
confirmation_rationale: The employee checks truck-tire pressure with a gauge while inflating and releasing air; the tire explodes immediately after the final check.

historical_description: Bore holes for insertion of screws or dowels, by hand or using boring machines.
official_description: Bore holes for insertion of screws or dowels, by hand or using boring machines.

rationale: Worker bored holes in a concrete wall and was entangled by the shaft; screw or dowel insertion purpose is not stated.

rationale: The affected worker helped set and align pilings over a creek; the specific structure being supported, a pier or bridge, is not stated.

historical_description: Relay messages about emergencies, accidents, locations of crew and personnel, and fire hazard conditions.
official_description: Relay messages about emergencies, accidents, locations of crew and personnel, and fire hazard conditions.

official_description: Conduct fire, safety, and sanitation inspections.

official_description: Test and repair track circuits.
rationale: Track removal supervision, door-track installation and repair, tank track positioning and conveyor wiring do not show testing and repairing railway track circuits.

official_description: Supervise or coordinate patient care or support staff activities.
rationale: Patient care, hospital support work, financial counseling and reception appear, but no supervision or coordination of patient-care/support staff activities by an incident-involved actor.

official_description: Operate towed machines such as seed drills or manure spreaders to plant, fertilize, dust, and spray crops.

incident_quote: The  employee was run over by the tractor, and then dragged by the grain/seed drill for approximately 180 feet.

historical_description: Mount and bolt sawing blades or attachments to machine shafts.
official_description: Mount and bolt sawing blades or attachments to machine shafts.

incident_quote: The unguarded, unrestrained saw blade flew out from the saw and into the face of Employee #1 operating the saw.
rationale: The affected saw operator and foreman mounted a new blade with an inadequately tightened arbor bolt, which later released the blade into his face.
confirmation_rationale: Employees explicitly install and bolt a replacement saw blade with a damaged arbor bolt. Its subsequent loosening releases the blade into the operator face, directly implicating the mounting task.

historical_description: Design water storage tanks or other water storage facilities.
official_description: Design water storage tanks or other water storage facilities.
rationale: Workers filled, constructed, painted or maintained storage tanks, with no design activity. Design cannot be inferred from tank failure.

historical_description: Rework, repair, or replace damaged parts or assemblies.
official_description: Rework, repair, or replace damaged parts or assemblies.

incident_quote: The employee partially amputated his thumb and was hospitalized.
rationale: The affected worker reworked a bent part on a press brake and pinched his thumb during the repeat bend.
confirmation_rationale: Reworking a bend on a manufactured part using the press brake is explicit; the repeated bend pinches and partially amputates the thumb.

historical_description: Lubricate moving parts on gate-crossing mechanisms and swinging signals.
official_description: Lubricate moving parts on gate-crossing mechanisms and swinging signals.
rationale: Opening and closing property gates, packer-gate troubleshooting, lift inspection and coil alignment do not establish lubricating crossing mechanisms or swinging signals.

official_description: Switch from automatic to manual controls and isolate equipment mechanically and electrically to allow for safe inspection and repair work.

rationale: Machine operator switched to manual for CNC setup, then unexpected movement crushed his hand; mechanical/electrical isolation and inspection/repair purpose are not demonstrated.

official_description: Manage safety programs at power generation facilities.
rationale: References to safety programs, manuals and training are background or investigation findings. Power-generator employment in one report concerns filter work and a spider bite, with no management of a safety program.

incident_quote: 15 EMPLOYEES WERE SENT TO A LOCAL HOSPITAL, WHERE THEY WERE TREATED AND RELEASED.
rationale: The contractor performed methane detection before the cloud exposure; this is an earlier site-safety activity, with the individual tester and direct exposure link unspecified.
confirmation_rationale: Methane-detection tests are explicitly reported before the unidentified cloud exposure, but no testing during that exposure or causal involvement is established. Retain prior testing as workflow context.

historical_description: Obtain fuel and oil samples and check them for contamination.
official_description: Obtain fuel and oil samples and check them for contamination.

incident_quote: He suffered the avulsion of skin from his legs and feet and an amputated toe.
rationale: Workers drained small oil quantities to check water contamination before loader movement injured the foreman; fuel sampling/checking is not shown.

historical_description: Operate power-driven pumps that transfer liquids, semi-liquids, gases, or powdered materials.
official_description: Operate power-driven pumps that transfer liquids, semi-liquids, gases, or powdered materials.

incident_quote: Employee #1 suffered chemical burns but was not hospitalized.
rationale: The affected employee transferred nitric acid with an electric drum pump and sustained chemical burns during the transfer.
confirmation_rationale: Electric drum-pump transfer of concentrated nitric acid is explicit and results in chemical burns.

historical_description: Set up and tear down equipment.
official_description: Set up and tear down equipment.
rationale: Equipment loading, hose repair, positioning a workpiece, standing on equipment and cleaning do not establish setting up and tearing down equipment.

historical_description: Collaborate with police to respond to accidents, disasters, and arson investigation calls.
official_description: Collaborate with police to respond to accidents, disasters, and arson investigation calls.
rationale: Police and firefighters responded to construction/tree incidents without responder injury or exposure. Collaboration in treatment after others' injuries does not establish an eligible incident-linked task.

historical_description: Attach rigging and signal crane or hoist operators to lift heavy frame and plate sections or other parts into place.
official_description: Attach rigging and signal crane or hoist operators to lift heavy frame and plate sections or other parts into place.
activity_quote: The riggers attached the girder to the two cranes' lifting beams and gave the signal for the lift to begin.
incident_quote: they found Employee # 1 had been crushed and killed under the west end of the girder.
rationale: Riggers attached a bridge girder and signaled its tandem crane lift; the suspended load directly killed the driver when a hoist line broke.
confirmation_rationale: Riggers explicitly attach the concrete girder to crane lifting beams and signal the lift. The load line fails during the initiated lift and kills the truck driver beneath it.

historical_description: Clean rooms and make beds.
official_description: Clean rooms and make beds.

incident_quote: She sustained a broken femur and hip and was hospitalized.
rationale: The injured nurse cleaned a bedroom wall with disinfectant, but making beds is absent.

historical_description: Decide when patients have recovered or stabilized enough to be sent to another room or ward or to be sent home following outpatient surgery.
official_description: Decide when patients have recovered or stabilized enough to be sent to another room or ward or to be sent home following outpatient surgery.
rationale: Surgery and discharge are subsequent treatment of injured employees. Forensic-patient restraint does not demonstrate deciding readiness for post-surgical transfer or discharge.

historical_description: Lay underground cable directly in trenches, or string it through conduit running through the trenches.
official_description: Lay underground cable directly in trenches, or string it through conduit running through the trenches.

incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained head trauma and was killed.
rationale: The affected employee pulled electrical cable through conduit, but it was near a warehouse ceiling rather than underground through trenches.

historical_description: Examine systems to locate problems, such as loose connections or broken insulation.
official_description: Examine systems to locate problems, such as loose connections or broken insulation.

incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained third-degree burns on both forearms and his right hand.
rationale: Affected managers examined a malfunctioning circuit breaker to locate the cause before an electrical fault burned them.
confirmation_rationale: Employees rack out and examine the breaker to locate the failure to close. Racking it back after this diagnostic examination produces the injurious arc.

historical_description: Remove finished cores, and stack or place them on conveyors for transfer to other work areas.
official_description: Remove finished cores, and stack or place them on conveyors for transfer to other work areas.
activity_quote: On the date of the accident the ejectors failed to push a core out of the box. Employee #1 then tried to pull the core piece out using his hands.
incident_quote: Employee #1 did not anticipate the closing of the box and the box closed on his right thumb, which was badly crushed and burned.
rationale: Core-machine worker manually removed a stuck baked core and crushed his thumb; stacking or conveyor placement for transfer by that actor is not shown in the incident.

historical_description: Pack or fold insulation between panels.
official_description: Pack or fold insulation between panels.
rationale: Roofers lay insulation across purlins, staple seams, retrieve insulation or cover it with roofing. None packs or folds insulation between panels; solar-panel work has no insulation activity.

historical_description: Test conductors, according to electrical diagrams and specifications, to identify corresponding conductors and to prevent incorrect connections.
official_description: Test conductors, according to electrical diagrams and specifications, to identify corresponding conductors and to prevent incorrect connections.

incident_quote: The ensuing electric arc burned the employee.
rationale: The affected electrician tested conductor phase relationships before connecting temporary service, but following diagrams and specifications is not stated.

historical_description: Lift equipment into position, using cranes and rigging tools or equipment, such as gin poles.
official_description: Lift equipment into position, using cranes and rigging tools or equipment, such as gin poles.
activity_quote: A crew of workers was rigging slings to lift a flatbed trailer by a truck with gin poles.
incident_quote: The metal gin poles and the block and tackle of the rigging equipment struck the employee on the head. He was killed.
rationale: Crew used gin-pole truck and rigging chains to lift a trailer for placement on another; collapse struck the worker directing the lift.
confirmation_rationale: A gin-pole truck and rigging lift a trailer into loading position during repeated attempts. The rigging falls onto the employee directing the lifting operation.

historical_description: Interview employers and employees to obtain information about work environments and workplace incidents.
official_description: Interview employers and employees to obtain information about work environments and workplace incidents.
rationale: Interviews with employers and workers are sources for later accident investigations. No affected or directly involved worker conducts these interviews during the reported incident.

historical_description: Reassemble timepieces, replacing glass faces and batteries, before returning them to customers.
official_description: Reassemble timepieces, replacing glass faces and batteries, before returning them to customers.
rationale: Lighting repair, firefighting, drywall work and electrical panel work do not establish reassembly of timepieces with new glass and batteries for customers.

historical_description: Identify environmental contamination sources.
official_description: Identify environmental contamination sources.
activity_quote: Employee #1 was instructed to enter a 1.5 million gal water tank to take water samples to determine what was contaminating the tank water.
incident_quote: The attending physician diagnosed Employee #1 as suffering a myocardial infarction due to the breathing of petroleum vapors.
rationale: Worker sampled tank water to determine contamination; diesel was found and he suffered myocardial infarction attributed to petroleum vapors during the sampling entry.
confirmation_rationale: The worker enters the tank and actually takes water samples to identify contamination; illness following exposure is diagnosed in the narrative as petroleum-vapor-associated myocardial infarction, and samples reveal diesel.

historical_description: Drive trucks to transport crews, materials, and equipment.
official_description: Drive trucks to transport crews, materials, and equipment.

incident_quote: He lost his balance or grip, fell backward, and landed on the forks and backrest of the forklift.
rationale: The affected driver transported products and a trailer-mounted forklift to a delivery site, then fell while accessing the load. Transport of crews is not evidenced.

historical_description: Apply chemicals to neutralize the effects of solvents.
activity_quote: SODA ASHWAS DISSOLVED IN WATER AND WAS BEING POURED FROM A BUCKET TO NEUTRALIZE THE SOLVENT.
incident_quote: HE WAS FOUND DEAD INSIDE THE TANK BY ANOTHER EMPLOYEE.
rationale: The affected worker neutralized acidic trichloroethylene with soda ash, then entered the emptied tank and died. Neutralization was earlier workflow before fatal tank entry.
confirmation_rationale: Soda-ash application to neutralize acidic solvent is explicit. The tank had then been pumped empty and the employee entered it with cleanup tools, where he was found dead. The chemical-application activity is prior workflow context; the reported text does not establish an injury during neutralizer application.

historical_description: Maintain quality of pool water by testing chemical levels.
official_description: Maintain quality of pool water by testing chemical levels.
rationale: Pool cleaning, chemical mixing and balancing-tank entry occur, but none tests pool chemical levels.

historical_description: Develop guidelines for procedures such as the management of viruses.
official_description: Develop guidelines for procedures such as the management of viruses.
rationale: Reports describe COVID illness and the absence of adequate infection-control policies. No affected worker develops procedure guidelines.

historical_description: Direct rig crews in drilling and other activities, such as setting up rigs and completing or servicing wells.
official_description: Direct rig crews in drilling and other activities, such as setting up rigs and completing or servicing wells.
rationale: Rig operators assist controls, setup and pipe handling, and supervisors inspect a tilted rig; actual directing of rig crews is not established by titles or those activities.

historical_description: Maintain equipment, making repairs or modifications when necessary.
official_description: Maintain equipment, making repairs or modifications when necessary.
activity_quote: However, the employee did not follow the company procedure and attempted to rehang the door himself.
incident_quote: As a result, the employee sustained a fractured hip.
rationale: Worker repaired a disconnected trailer door by rehanging it, then fell while maneuvering it; conditional repairs are directly demonstrated.
confirmation_rationale: Repairing the disconnected trailer door by rehanging it is explicit; the worker falls while maneuvering it from stacked pallets.

historical_description: Place tiles, nail them to roof boards, and cover nailheads with roofing cement.
official_description: Place tiles, nail them to roof boards, and cover nailheads with roofing cement.

incident_quote: Employee #1 suffered fractures to his right arm.
rationale: The affected roofer marked layout lines for tiles, an installation preparation step, but placement, nailing and cementing nailheads are not described.

official_description: Splice or solder cables together or to overhead transmission lines, customer service lines, or street light lines, using hand tools, epoxies, or specialized equipment.

rationale: The affected worker spliced two power lines, but hand tools, epoxy or specialized equipment are not specified.

incident_quote: While collecting the samples, she was exposed to Campylobacter jejuni during the research project to evaluate the efficacy of an ultraviolet light process for sterilization of food products and food processing effluent.
rationale: Research associate collected and tested chiller wash-water samples and became ill during the project; whether this is a cleaning solution rather than food-processing effluent is unclear, and exposure etiology was inconclusive.

historical_description: Remove litter and debris from roadways, including debris from rock and mud slides.

incident_quote: The employee was struck by a motorist and killed.
rationale: The affected worker removed highway debris on foot and was struck by traffic while doing so.
confirmation_rationale: The worker removes road debris on foot in the highway lane and is struck and killed by a vehicle.

historical_description: Develop employee health and safety policies.
official_description: Develop employee health and safety policies.
rationale: Reports describe policies present, absent or evaluated after incidents, not an eligible worker developing health and safety policies.

official_description: Clean and maintain tanks, filter beds, and other work areas, using hand tools and power tools.

rationale: Employee power-washed tank exteriors before a tank fire burned him; filter beds, other work areas, and maintenance using both hand and power tools are not all demonstrated.

official_description: Operate machines to flush earth cuttings or to blow dust from holes.

rationale: The affected worker operated a blower to remove ground pavement-marking dust. The dust was on the roadway, not inside holes, and flushing earth cuttings is not described.

historical_description: Direct and supervise work of embalmers, funeral attendants, death certificate clerks, cosmetologists, or other staff.
official_description: Direct and supervise work of embalmers, funeral attendants, death certificate clerks, cosmetologists, or other staff.

historical_description: Monitor for trains at railroad crossings and signal the bus driver when it is safe to proceed.
official_description: Monitor for trains at railroad crossings and signal the bus driver when it is safe to proceed.

official_description: Operate or tend machines to wash and remove impurities from items such as barrels or kegs, glass products, tin plate surfaces, dried fruit, pulp, animal stock, coal, manufactured articles, plastic, or rubber.

historical_description: Position patterns inside mold sections, and clamp sections together.

official_description: Plan and coordinate airfield construction.

historical_description: Check the forms that hold the concrete to see that they are properly constructed.

rationale: The operator detects failure to stamp and troubleshoots a stencil machine, then is caught when sensors cycle it. Observation of lights and gauges to detect malfunction is not stated.

historical_description: Pour water into wells, or pump water or slush into wells to cool drill bits and to remove drillings.

official_description: Conduct or coordinate worker training in areas such as safety laws and regulations, hazardous condition monitoring, and use of safety equipment.

historical_description: Place intercept circuits on terminals to handle vacant lines in central office installations.

official_description: Guide and assist crews laying track and resetting supports and blocking.

official_description: Fit inner tubes and final layers of rubber onto tires.

official_description: Fasten small metal or plastic boxes to walls to house electrical switches or outlets.

official_description: Install gas burners to convert furnaces from wood, coal, or oil.

historical_description: Train operators, engineers, or other personnel.
official_description: Train operators, engineers, or other personnel.

confirmation_rationale: Diagnosis of the cooling fault occurred on the prior visit, weeks before fatal contact during fuse replacement. Diagnosis is an explicit prior task mention, retained only as context for the later repair incident.

historical_description: Solder posts and parts to hold them in their proper places.
official_description: Solder posts and parts to hold them in their proper places.

historical_description: Steer vessels and operate navigational instruments.
official_description: Steer vessels and operate navigational instruments.
rationale: Boat movement on a trailer, tank work, and barge dredging do not establish steering a vessel and operating navigational instruments.

official_description: Operate equipment, such as excavators, backhoes, rock hammers, trench compactors, pavement saws, grout mixers or pumps, geothermal loop reels, and coil tubing units (CTU).

historical_description: Clean and salt hides.
official_description: Clean and salt hides.

official_description: Monitor machine operation, and make adjustments as necessary to ensure proper operation.

rationale: The worker observes the running seamer, identifies poor operation, and adjusts it with a hammer immediately before injury.
confirmation_rationale: The worker observes seamer operation, judges it unsatisfactory, and makes a further guide-rail adjustment with a hammer. Finger entrapment occurs during that adjustment.

historical_description: Examine employee files to answer inquiries and provide information for personnel actions.
official_description: Examine employee files to answer inquiries and provide information for personnel actions.

official_description: Plan, schedule or supervise the work of other employees.

historical_description: Train users in details of system operation.
official_description: Train users in details of system operation.

rationale: A directly involved forklift operator pushes a billet cart into a curing oven, displacing the cart that injures the victim. Forklift transfer to a curing oven is present, but the material is aluminum billets rather than clay structures.

historical_description: Operate cranes, or signal crane operators to position or remove stone from cars or saw beds.

rationale: Workers crane-lift a stone from the crane bed, but the specified cars or saw beds are not established. The electrical contact is a hazardous incident despite no injuries.

official_description: Transfer equipment, objects, or parts to specified work areas, using moving devices.
rationale: Moving equipment appears in settings and mechanisms, but reports do not establish a qualifying worker transferring equipment, objects, or parts to specified work areas. Fuel transfer is bulk liquid handling, not specified objects/parts.

official_description: Store items in an orderly and accessible manner in warehouses, tool rooms, supply rooms, or other areas.

historical_description: Sample and test air to identify gasses, such as bromine, ozone, or sulfur dioxide, or particulates, such as mold, dust, or allergens.
official_description: Sample and test air to identify gasses, such as bromine, ozone, or sulfur dioxide, or particulates, such as mold, dust, or allergens.
rationale: Air or gas sampling is postincident investigation or unlinked analysis. No affected or directly causally involved worker samples and tests air as the incident activity.

official_description: Install horizontal and vertical metal or wooden studs to frames so that wallboard can be attached to interior walls.

incident_quote: Employee #1 had fallen with the scaffold, and his head struck again st the lower metal wall tracking and the floor.
rationale: The affected worker measured for installation of vertical interior-wall studs while a coworker cut them; actual installation, horizontal members, and wallboard purpose are not fully established.

historical_description: Load hoppers, containers, or conveyors to feed machines with products, using forklifts, transfer augers, suction gates, shovels, or pitchforks.
official_description: Load hoppers, containers, or conveyors to feed machines with products, using forklifts, transfer augers, suction gates, shovels, or pitchforks.

incident_quote: The load shifted and caused the press to move and crush Employee #1 between it and the wall.
rationale: A directly involved forklift transfers a load into a hopper beside the grape press; the overloaded arrangement shifts and moves the press into the victim. This is mechanical hopper loading to feed production equipment.
confirmation_rationale: The narrative reports a forklift transfer into a hopper that shifts the adjacent grape press and crushes the worker. The source uses apparently for the transfer and injury description; retain that reported uncertainty rather than presenting it as independently established.

historical_description: Climb wind turbine towers to inspect, maintain, or repair equipment.
official_description: Climb wind turbine towers to inspect, maintain, or repair equipment.

incident_quote: he died from head and body fractures from impact with the ladder and the concrete floor.
rationale: The technicians work at height inside a wind turbine replacing blade bolts, and one falls while descending its internal ladder; climbing the turbine for maintenance is established.
confirmation_rationale: Wind-turbine blade-bolt replacement and descent on the tower internal ladder are explicit. The employee falls during that tower access/descent and dies.

historical_description: Report need for police or medical assistance to sheriff's office.
official_description: Report need for police or medical assistance to sheriff's office.
rationale: Requests for police or medical help are postevent responses by unendangered people; no qualifying incident-exposed worker reports the need to a sheriffs office.

rationale: The affected employee cut pork into cubes with a bandsaw, but carcass processing on an assembly line and performance of selected line cuts are not established.

incident_quote: EMPLOYEE #1'S HAND WAS AMPUTATED AT THE WRIST.
rationale: Machine setup through control-panel toggle switches is explicit, but computer use to set machinery performance is not. The computer-controlled welding example concerns lubrication.

historical_description: Write and present reports of research findings.
official_description: Write and present reports of research findings.

rationale: The employee removes excess glue from conveyor machinery and is caught by a shaft. Glue removal is explicit, but the glue is not on joints and knife/scraper/chisel use is not stated.

incident_quote: The corner broke off, and Employee #1 fell into the deeper electrical trench, a fall height of 7 feet.

incident_quote: The employee tested positive for COVID-19 and was hospitalized for treatment of his infection on May 14, 2023.
rationale: A respiratory therapist performs breathing treatments on patients, but medication administration and monitoring for reactions or side effects are not explicit. Other examples concern self-medication, postincident treatment, or fetching a prescription.

rationale: The worker removes a previously cut piece from a saw table, but hand-tool use and placing completed pieces in containers are absent.

incident_quote: His middle finger was amputated
rationale: The crew uses a tractor-pulled cauliflower transplanter whose seats and feed wheel are described, then workers are injured adjusting it. This supports transplanting-machine work, but the injured foreman personally feeding plants while riding/walking at specified intervals is not established.

rationale: Worker connected piping and valves to a wellhead before pressure testing, but identification of the valves as pressure-control devices is not explicit. Other reports involve removal or preparation for valve replacement.

historical_description: Train or instruct employees in job duties or company policies or arrange for training to be provided.
official_description: Train or instruct employees in job duties or company policies or arrange for training to be provided.
rationale: Job training was provided in response to the accident; it was not the incident-involved activity.

historical_description: Cut grooves, bevels, or miters, saw curved or irregular designs, and sever or shape metals, according to specifications or work orders.
official_description: Cut grooves, bevels, or miters, saw curved or irregular designs, and sever or shape metals, according to specifications or work orders.

historical_description: Work with others to change advertising displays.
official_description: Work with others to change advertising displays.

confirmation_rationale: Helping remove the billboard vinyl covering supports collaborative advertising-display replacement, beyond mere work at a sign. The worker removes its stretch pole, contacts a power line with it, and suffers fatal shock or fall injuries.

incident_quote: He had been run over by the loader and killed .
rationale: The recycling crew supervisor operated a loader in the joint cleanup, directly striking the worker, but actual supervision of workers is not separately described beyond his title.

historical_description: Review files, records, and other documents to obtain information to respond to requests.
official_description: Review files, records, and other documents to obtain information to respond to requests.

historical_description: Seal joints with putty, mortar, and asbestos, using putty extruders and knives.
official_description: Seal joints with putty, mortar, and asbestos, using putty extruders and knives.

historical_description: Massage, shampoo, and condition patron's hair and scalp to clean them and remove excess oil.
official_description: Massage, shampoo, and condition patron's hair and scalp to clean them and remove excess oil.
rationale: Cat bathing is animal grooming, not patron hair/scalp massage, shampoo and conditioning. Other cleaning and singed-hair examples are unrelated.

historical_description: Operate and maintain finishing machines to grind, drill, sand, bevel, decorate, wash, or polish glass or glass products.
official_description: Operate and maintain finishing machines to grind, drill, sand, bevel, decorate, wash, or polish glass or glass products.
rationale: A glass-department employee has unspecified processing duties; other cases grind pigments or steel pipes or work in a paper mill. No operation and maintenance of glass-finishing machines is established.

historical_description: Conduct classes or demonstrations, or train other workers.
official_description: Conduct classes or demonstrations, or train other workers.

official_description: Perform endotracheal intubation to maintain open airways for patients who are unable to breathe on their own.
rationale: Intubation is postexposure treatment of an excavator operator, not the injured worker task.

historical_description: Turn meters on or off to establish or close service.
official_description: Turn meters on or off to establish or close service.

official_description: Mold or install ornamental plaster pieces, panels, or trim.

incident_quote: Employee #1 fell from a scaffold with no fall protection.

historical_description: Select proper types of plates according to press run lengths.

official_description: Perform minor repairs to machines, such as replacing damaged or worn parts.

official_description: Provide expert testimony in employment lawsuits.

official_description: Provide physicians with assistance during surgery or complicated medical procedures.

official_description: Assemble and position equipment, explosives, and blasting caps in holes at specified depths, or load perforating guns or torpedoes with explosives.

historical_description: Mix sealing compounds by hand or with portable electric mixers.
official_description: Mix sealing compounds by hand or with portable electric mixers.

official_description: Clean shelves, counters, and tables.

official_description: Wash dishes, glassware, and silverware after meals.

confirmation_rationale: Dish cleaning after breakfast is explicitly identified as the current activity. The worker turns and trips into an operating mixer in that work area, resulting in finger amputation.

official_description: Test products for moisture content, using moisture meters.

rationale: Worker checked paper moisture content, but use of a moisture meter is not stated; date-sample grinding similarly prepares moisture testing without a specified meter.

rationale: Reshaping a tank manway and stacking scrap containers do not establish assembling foundry patterns/flasks or reinforcing core boxes.

historical_description: Collect body tissue, feces, blood, urine, or other body fluids for examination and analysis.
official_description: Collect body tissue, feces, blood, urine, or other body fluids for examination and analysis.

incident_quote: He died at 10:00 a.m. on April 9, 2020.

confirmation_rationale: Blood collection and specimen analysis are explicit laboratory activities. The source only alleges coronavirus exposure, says it is uncertain, and describes fluids as potentially positive; it does not establish an infected source or task-specific exposure. Retain task presence as context.

incident_quote: The bond cables hit the bottom of the third rail creating an arc flash or electrical explosion.
rationale: The affected employee repairs an electrical bond connection to a running rail, a substantive rail-system repair, but assistance installing or repairing rails and ties themselves is not established.

historical_description: Inspect boarding and locking of open-top box cars and wedging of side-drop and hopper cars to prevent loss of material in transit.
rationale: Unsafe scrap railcar loading is an incident condition during switching, not an inspection of boarding, locking or wedging; other examples involve electrical boxes and forklifts.

official_description: Report delays, mechanical problems, and emergencies to supervisors or dispatchers, using radios.

incident_quote: The belt turned on and caught the employee's left-hand middle and index fingers and started pulling his hand into the rollers.
rationale: Radio communication about conveyor alignment supports reporting mechanical difficulties within the crew, but reports of delays and emergencies to supervisors/dispatchers before injury are not established. Postincident radio calls for rescue are excluded.

rationale: The affected worker tests a battery bank, but charging batteries is not documented.

historical_description: Clean or make minor repairs to machines or equipment.
official_description: Clean or make minor repairs to machines or equipment.

incident_quote: Employee #1 sustained lacerations to his hand, for which he was hospitalized.

confirmation_rationale: The soup-machine operator cleans the hopper gate with a brush. The energized gate closes on the hand holding that brush and causes hospitalized lacerations.

historical_description: Discuss with offenders how such issues as drug and alcohol abuse and anger management problems might have played roles in their criminal behavior.
official_description: Discuss with offenders how such issues as drug and alcohol abuse and anger management problems might have played roles in their criminal behavior.

incident_quote: The employee apparently lost his balance while getting the new replacement hose and fell to the floor, hitting his head.
rationale: Obtaining a replacement hose for a leaking carwash system is a concrete equipment-maintenance step; cleaning equipment, areas or shelves is not documented.

official_description: Repair or replace parts such as pistons, rods, gears, valves, and bearings.

rationale: Worker was opening access for a malfunctioning torque-cylinder repair, but repair or replacement itself had not begun; the other case is normal press operation with piston failure.

rationale: The employee performed managerial work supervising civilian employees, with close coworker contact during those duties before COVID hospitalization. Supervision is an explicit personnel activity.
confirmation_rationale: The employee explicitly supervises civilian staff and schedules work. COVID hospitalization and some coworker proximity are stated, but no infected coworker or exposure linked to a personnel action is identified. This supports a contextual task mention.

rationale: Sewing almond sacks, a speculative upholstery-shop fire and repairing a weaving-machine drive do not establish sewing garments.

official_description: Lift and position workpieces, manually or with hoists, and secure them in hoppers or on machine tables, faceplates, or chucks, using clamps.

incident_quote: THE KNIFE SLIPPED OUT OF THE HAM, CAUSING THE EMPLOYEE TO INADVERTENTLY PULL THE KNIFE TOWARD HIMSELF AND CUT HIMSELF IN THE LEFT EYE.
rationale: The injured worker explicitly boned hams on a meat-packing conveyor, but cutting/butchering and the before-cooking qualification are not established.

official_description: Inspect, examine, or test installed systems or pipe lines, using pressure gauge, hydrostatic testing, observation, or other methods.

confirmation_rationale: The pipeline is actually held at pressure for an hour as part of hydrostatic testing, beyond mere preparation. A weld failure releases water and pressure and seriously injures the three workers.
